translations.it.karamati: Tutto il mio essere dimora accanto a lui, come suo Servitore, per suo tramite: per lui sono divenuto vicino, io che ero lontano.
translations.en.karamati: My whole being dwells beside him, as his Servant, through him: through him I have become near, I who was far.
translations.fr.karamati: Tout mon être demeure auprès de lui, en son Serviteur, par lui : par lui je suis devenu proche, moi qui étais lointain.

bayts.text: يُصَيِّرُنِى كَالْئَالِ وَالصَّحْبِ سَرْمَدًا ۞ وَلِى قَادَ سِرًّا غَابَ عَنْ خَيْرِهِ الْمُحْىِ

translations.it.karamati: Egli mi rende per sempre come la sua Famiglia e i suoi Compagni, e ha condotto a me un segreto celato persino ai migliori, (per grazia di) Colui che dà la vita (Allah).
translations.en.karamati: He makes me forever like his Family and his Companions, and has led to me a secret hidden even from the best, (by the grace of) the Giver of life (Allah).
translations.fr.karamati: Il me rend à jamais comme sa Famille et ses Compagnons, et il a conduit vers moi un secret caché même aux meilleurs, (par la grâce de) Celui qui donne la vie (Allah).

bayts.text: يُصَلِّى بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَيْهِ بِئَالِهِ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ بَاقٍ بِهِ فُزْتُ بِالطَّىِّ

translations.it.karamati: L'Eterno (Allah) effonde benedizione e pace su di lui, sulla sua Famiglia e sui suoi Compagni; per suo tramite ho ottenuto il trionfo nell'accorciarsi (prodigioso) del cammino (ṭayy).
translations.en.karamati: The Everlasting (Allah) pours blessing and peace upon him, his Family and his Companions; through him I have attained triumph in the (wondrous) folding of the way (ṭayy).
translations.fr.karamati: L'Éternel (Allah) répand prière et paix sur lui, sur sa Famille et sur ses Compagnons ; par lui j'ai obtenu le triomphe dans le raccourcissement (prodigieux) du chemin (ṭayy).

bayts.text: يُصَلِّى عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ بِالْئَالِ كُلِّهِمْ ۞ وَأَصْحَابِهِ مُغْنٍ عَنِ الْكَدِّ وَالْقَنْىِ

translations.it.karamati: Effonde la Sua benedizione sull'Eletto (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), su tutta la sua Famiglia e sui suoi Compagni, Colui che rende liberi dalla fatica e dall'accumulare.
translations.en.karamati: He who frees from toil and from hoarding pours His blessing upon the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), upon all his Family and his Companions.
translations.fr.karamati: Répand Sa prière sur l'Élu (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), sur toute sa Famille et sur ses Compagnons, Celui qui affranchit de la peine et de l'accumulation.

bayts.text: يُخَاطِبُنِى مَا قِيدَ لِى بِامْدَحَنَّهُ ۞ مَدِيحًا عَجِيبًا مُّفْحِمًا فَائِقَ الرَّأْىِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi parla ciò che mi è stato condotto: «Lodalo!», con un elogio meraviglioso, che ammutolisce e supera ogni giudizio.
translations.en.karamati: There speaks to me what has been led to me: "Praise him!", with a wondrous eulogy, that silences and surpasses all judgement.
translations.fr.karamati: Me parle ce qui m'a été conduit : « Loue-le ! », d'un éloge merveilleux, qui réduit au silence et dépasse tout jugement.

bayts.text: يَقُولُ لِسَانُ الْحَالِ لِى كُنْ خَدِيمَ مَنْ ۞ حَمَاكَ عَنِ الْأَكْدَارِ بِاللَّهِ ذَا رَعْىِ

translations.it.karamati: La lingua del mio stato mi dice: «Sii il Servitore di colui (Muḥammad) che ti ha protetto dai turbamenti, per (grazia di) Allah, con premurosa cura».
translations.en.karamati: The tongue of my state says to me: "Be the Servant of him (Muḥammad) who has protected you from troubles, by (the grace of) God, with attentive care."
translations.fr.karamati: La langue de mon état me dit : « Sois le Serviteur de celui (Muḥammad) qui t'a protégé des troubles, par (la grâce de) Dieu, avec une sollicitude attentive ».

bayts.text: يَقِينِى إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ بَاقٍ يُحِبُنِى ۞ عِدَاهُ وَبِالْمُخْتَارِ كُلِّيَّتِى يُحْىِ

translations.it.karamati: (È) mia certezza, fino ai Giardini, che l'Eterno mi ama (e allontana da me) i Suoi nemici, e che per mezzo dell'Eletto (Muḥammad) Egli dà vita a tutto il mio essere.
translations.en.karamati: (It is) my certainty, unto the Gardens, that the Everlasting loves me (and keeps from me) His enemies, and that through the Chosen One (Muḥammad) He gives life to my whole being.
translations.fr.karamati: (C'est) ma certitude, jusqu'aux Jardins, que l'Éternel m'aime (et écarte de moi) Ses ennemis, et que par l'Élu (Muḥammad) Il donne vie à tout mon être.

bayts.text: مَلَّكْتُ بِرَبِّى مُخْجِلَ الْمَوْجِ وَالْيَمِّ ۞ بِمَدْحِ الَّذِى أَنْسَى أَذَى الْفُلْكِ كَالْغَمِّ

translations.it.karamati: Per (grazia del) mio Signore ho ricevuto in possesso ciò che fa arrossire l'onda e il mare, lodando colui (Muḥammad) che mi ha fatto dimenticare l'offesa della nave, come (si dimentica) l'angoscia.
translations.en.karamati: By (the grace of) my Lord I have been given possession of what puts the wave and the sea to shame, by praising him (Muḥammad) who made me forget the ship's harm, as (one forgets) anguish.
translations.fr.karamati: Par (la grâce de) mon Seigneur j'ai reçu en possession ce qui fait rougir la vague et la mer, en louant celui (Muḥammad) qui m'a fait oublier le mal du navire, comme (l'on oublie) l'angoisse.

bayts.text: مَرَامِى وَحَاجَاتِى لِرَبِّى تَوَجَّهَتْ ۞ بِحَمْدٍ وَشُكْرٍ وَهْوَ لِى كَانَ بِالشُّكْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio intento e i miei bisogni si sono volti al mio Signore, con lode e rendimento di grazie, ed Egli è stato con me colmandomi di doni.
translations.en.karamati: My aim and my needs have turned to my Lord, with praise and thanksgiving, and He has been with me, lavishing gifts upon me.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon dessein et mes besoins se sont tournés vers mon Seigneur, avec louange et action de grâce, et Il a été avec moi en me comblant de dons.

bayts.text: مُرَادِىَ كَوْنِى عَبْدَ رَبِّى خَدِيمَ مَنْ ۞ أُخَاطِبُهُ بِالشُّكْرِ وَالْحُبِّ ذَا عَزْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio desiderio è essere servo del mio Signore e Servitore (Khadīm) di colui (Muḥammad) al quale mi rivolgo con gratitudine e amore, con ferma risolutezza.
translations.en.karamati: My desire is to be servant of my Lord and Servant (Khadīm) of him (Muḥammad) whom I address with gratitude and love, with firm resolve.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon désir est d'être serviteur de mon Seigneur et Serviteur (Khadīm) de celui (Muḥammad) à qui je m'adresse avec reconnaissance et amour, avec une ferme résolution.

bayts.text: مَزَايَاكَ يَاكُلِّى لَدَى الْكُلِّ قَدْ جَلَتْ ۞ وَلَا كِنَّهَا جَلَّتْ عَنِ الشِّعْرِ والنَّظْمِ

translations.it.karamati: I tuoi pregi, o mio tutto, sono manifesti a tutti; ma essi sono troppo sublimi per la poesia e per il verso.
translations.en.karamati: Your merits, O my all, are manifest to all; but they are too sublime for poetry and verse.
translations.fr.karamati: Tes mérites, ô mon tout, sont manifestes à tous ; mais ils sont trop sublimes pour la poésie et pour le vers.

bayts.text: مَقَامَاتُ خَيْرِ الْخَلْقِ عَنْ غَيْرِ رَبِّهِ ۞ مُقَيَّبَةٌ فَلْتَقْرَ أَنْ سُورَةَ النَّجْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Le stazioni spirituali del migliore delle creature sono velate (muqayyaba) a chiunque non sia il suo Signore: leggi dunque la Sura della Stella (an-Najm).
translations.en.karamati: The spiritual stations of the best of creatures are veiled (muqayyaba) from any but his Lord: so recite the Sūra of the Star (an-Najm).
translations.fr.karamati: Les stations spirituelles du meilleur des créatures sont voilées (muqayyaba) à quiconque n'est pas son Seigneur : lis donc la sourate de l'Étoile (an-Najm).

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمُخْتَارُ لَا خَلْقَ مِثْلُهُ ۞ عَلَيْهِ سَلَامَا مَنْ لَهُ الْأَمْرُ كَالْحُكْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Eletto (Al-Mukhtār): non vi è creatura simile a lui; su di lui i due saluti di pace di Colui (Allah) al Quale appartengono il comando e il giudizio.
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad, the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār): there is no creature like him; upon him the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) to whom belong command and judgement.
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad, l'Élu (Al-Mukhtār) : il n'est nulle créature semblable à lui ; sur lui les deux saluts de paix de Celui (Allah) à qui appartiennent le commandement et le jugement.

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٌ الْمَعْرُوفُ مَاحٍ وَمَانِحٌ ۞ وَبِالْعِزِّ مَخَصُوصٌ مَّصُونٌ عَنِ الْوَصْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad, il Conosciuto, Colui che cancella e che dona, prediletto con la gloria, preservato da ogni macchia.
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad, the Renowned, the Effacer and the Giver, singled out with glory, guarded from every stain.
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad, le Connu, Celui qui efface et qui donne, distingué par la gloire, préservé de toute souillure.

bayts.text: مُجِيبٌ مُّجَابٌ مُّرْتَضًى مُّهْلِكٌ عِدَى ۞ مُبِيحٌ وَمَبْعُوثٌ إِلَى الْعُرْبِ وَالْعُجْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Colui che esaudisce e che è esaudito, il Gradito, che annienta i nemici, che rende lecito (il bene), inviato agli Arabi e ai non Arabi.
translations.en.karamati: He who answers and is answered, the Well-pleasing, destroyer of enemies, who makes (the good) lawful, sent to the Arabs and the non-Arabs.
translations.fr.karamati: Celui qui exauce et qui est exaucé, l'Agréé, qui anéantit les ennemis, qui rend licite (le bien), envoyé aux Arabes et aux non-Arabes.

bayts.text: مُضِىءٌ جَلَا عَنَّا دُجَانَا مُحَلِّلٌ ۞ مَلِيحٌ وَمَعْصُومٌ مِّنْ النَّاسِ وَالوَهْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Luminoso, egli ha dissipato da noi le nostre tenebre, rende lecito (ciò che è puro), bello, preservato (da Dio) dagli uomini e dall'illusione.
translations.en.karamati: Luminous, he has dispelled our darkness from us, he makes lawful (what is pure), handsome, protected (by God) from people and from delusion.
translations.fr.karamati: Lumineux, il a dissipé loin de nous nos ténèbres, il rend licite (ce qui est pur), beau, préservé (par Dieu) des hommes et de l'illusion.

bayts.text: مَدِينَةُ عِلْمِ مُّرْتَجًى مِّنَّةٌ لَّنَا ۞ جَرِىءٌ وَمُنْجٍ مِنْ ذُنُوبٍ وَمِنْ ظُلْمِ

translations.it.karamati: Città della scienza, lo Sperato, grazia (divina) per noi, impavido e salvatore dai peccati e dall'ingiustizia.
translations.en.karamati: City of knowledge, the Hoped-for, a (divine) grace for us, fearless and saviour from sins and from injustice.
translations.fr.karamati: Cité de la science, l'Espéré, grâce (divine) pour nous, intrépide et sauveur des péchés et de l'injustice.

bayts.text: مَحَا اللَّهُ عَنِّى بِالنَّبِى كُلَّ فَاسِدٍ ۞ وَصِرْتُ بِهِ عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا بِلَا غَمِّ

translations.it.karamati: Allah ha cancellato da me, per mezzo del Profeta, ogni corruzione, e per lui sono divenuto servo e Servitore (Khadīm), senza angoscia.
translations.en.karamati: God has erased from me, through the Prophet, all corruption, and through him I have become servant and Servant (Khadīm), without anguish.
translations.fr.karamati: Dieu a effacé de moi, par le Prophète, toute corruption, et par lui je suis devenu serviteur et Serviteur (Khadīm), sans angoisse.

bayts.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ أَبْغِى صَلَاتَهُ ۞ بِتَسْلِيمِهِ لِلْمُصْطَفَى الْمُخْجِلِ الْيَمِّ

translations.it.karamati: Da Allah, Signore del Trono, imploro la Sua benedizione, insieme alla Sua pace, per il Prescelto (Muḥammad), che fa arrossire il mare (con la sua generosità).
translations.en.karamati: From God, Lord of the Throne, I implore His blessing, together with His peace, for the Chosen One (Muḥammad), who puts the sea to shame (by his generosity).
translations.fr.karamati: De Dieu, Maître du Trône, j'implore Sa prière, avec Sa paix, pour l'Élu (Muḥammad), qui fait rougir la mer (par sa générosité).

verses.transcription: al hamdu lil laahil lazii yusallii
fil aali was sahbi wa man waalaahu
wa amaral amlaaka aydan bis salaah
yal laahu salli abadan wa sallimaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: يَامَنْ بِهِ وَهَبْتَ لِى خَيْرَ عُلُومْ
verses.transcription: yaa man bihi wa habta lii khayra huluum
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man yuwassilu lizii hashrin mi-ah
bijaahihi yaa man hamaa han sayyi-ah
suu-an wa yuuqizus sahiida min wasan
sallal munaa wa fil jinaani yulfaa
yal laahu salli abadan wa sallimi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa suntanii han maradin wa alami
wa lii bihi wa habta fii haadaatii
wa lii bihi qad judtta bil kitaabi

yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: بَاقٍ لَّدَيْهِ النَّفْعُ قُدْتَّ لِى الْعُلُومْ
verses.transcription: baaqin ladayhin nafhu qudtta lil huluum
salli salaatan min wuquufin wa kasal
maanihatan yaa man adaama lil hasal

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ مَالِىَ تَجُودُ مِنْ مُّبَاحْ
verses.transcription: fii kulli maa liya tajuudu min mubaah

wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa ahtinit taqwaa wa yassir liya maa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man bihim saaqa lighayrii dayraa

yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
halal lazii laka bihi wa saltu

wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahta lii mahar ridaa bil waasihi

lii qudtta waajiban wa manduuban mahaa
maa lam tuhibba lii mudiima khayrii
saffaa bihaa lil humra wad duyuuraa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liya khatta mahat tilaawah
wa fii siwaahumaa minal lazii tubiih

verses.text: لِى يَامُبِيحًا صَانَ ذَاتِى عَنْ قَبِيحْ
verses.transcription: lii yaa mubiihan saana zaatii han qabiih
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa
yaa rabbanaa yaa khillanaa yaa hibbanaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
lakas sanaa wal hamdu wash shukru mahaa

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى فَضْلَكَ لِى قَدْ جَمَعَا
verses.transcription: halal lazii fadlaka lii qad jamahaa
wal arda yaa man qaada lii namaa-aa
wa yamla-ul kursiyya yaa zal farshi

verses.text: وَيُدْ خِلَانِ الْبِشْرَ فِى قَلْبِ النَّبِى
verses.transcription: wa yud khilaanil bishra fii qalbin nabii
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wal hummadi
munawwaran yaa zal hulaa wat tawli

verses.text: وَلِىَ هَبْ كَوْنَكَ لِى فِيهِ وَفِى
verses.transcription: wa liya hab kawnaka lii fiihi wa fii
siwaahu min jumlati maa minnii yafii
wa saffi lii haqaa-idii wa qawlii
wa hamalii wa khuluqii yaa hawlii
himraana fil haali wa fil ma-aali
wa hab liyal fat-ha wa yassiril huluum
liya wa zidnii minka hilman yaa haliim
wa habta liya min fadlikal haziimi
maa qaadanii lish shukri bin naziimi
lii kunta fil mammarri wal awtaani
yaa munzilan khayral hudaa yaa raafihah
yal laahu salli abadan wa sallimaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lanaa bihis siraatal mustaqiim
wa hab lanal iimaana wal islaamaa
wa hab lanaa salaamatal quluubi min
huyuubi nafsin yaa muqiitan qad damin
wa hab lanal hismata yaa wahhaabu
yaa man lahul iyaabu waz zahaabu
wa hab lanal yaqiina wat tamkiinaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَاكْتُبْ لَهُ فِى كُلِّ مَا مِنِّى يَفِى
verses.transcription: waktub lahu fii kulli maa minnii yafii
maa sarrahu yaa man yasuunu hiyafii
yal laahu salli waltusallim kulla hiin
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa bil lazii yasuu-u qalbii azhibi
yaa man yaquudu lii dawaamanan nijaal
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَلِىَ هَبْ فِى الْخَطِّ مَالَيْسَ يَكُونْ
verses.transcription: wa liya hab fil khatti maa laysa yakuun
li-ahadin yaa man lahu kun fayakun

verses.text: وَاكْتُبْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ مَصُونًا لَّمْ يُرَا
verses.transcription: waktub liyal yawma masuunan lam yuraa
khattu lighayrii wa lighayrii lan yuraa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
yaa man bihi lii judtta bit taqdiimi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma masuunan muskitaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
man lam yuhibbuunii lighayrii zaa haliib
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
lighayri zaatiya wa maa lam yuhmadaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa liya awsil lil jinaani samanii
yaa baaqiyan qad kunta lii bi-amani
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
salli salaatan lii tajuudu bil ghuyuub
bilaa azan wa lii yukhallidul haliib
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu fiyya masarraatin taduum
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
bilaa iqaalatin wa qudtta lii rabiih
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: عَنْ كُلِّ مَالَمْ تَرْضَ لِى ذَاصَوْمِ
verses.transcription: han kulli maa lam tarda lii zaa sawmi
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
minnish tarayta silahii wa qudtta lii

verses.text: صَلِّ صَلَاةً لِّى تَقُودُ كُلَّ مَا
verses.transcription: salli salaatan lii taquudu kulla maa
likh tartahu wal qalba minnii hallimaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa khaaliqan maa shi-tu yaa mu-asiru
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
maha salaamin lii yajuudu bil wafaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa sun jihaatii kullahaa han kadari
wa hab liyas safaa-a fil layaalii

verses.text: لِغَيْرِ ذَاتِى وَاحْمِنِى عَنْ كُلِّ كَدّْ
verses.transcription: lighayri zaatii wahminii han kulli kadd
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
yaa haasimii min khata-in wa hamdi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyat taawiila wat tafsiiraa
wa fil kitaabi wal hadiisi hab lii
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hamalii lil khayri kal ahwaali
yaa man mahal ghurbata wal imlaaqaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa qudtta lin nusrata wat takriimaa

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى لَكَ بِهِ انْتَهَى الْمَسِيرْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii laka bihin tahal masiir
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa qud humaa bikhayri khayrin lil jinaan
wa kulliyah sim waltunawwir lil janaan

verses.text: لِى اشْهَدْ بِشُكْرِى لَكَ فِى الْفَرْدِ رَجَبْ
verses.transcription: lish had bishukrii laka fil fardi rajab
wa fii siwaahu yaa mudiiman lil hajab
sanaa-a baaqin kaana lii yaa muhsii
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى كَوْنُكَ لِى بِهِ ظَهَرْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii kawnuka lii bihi zahar
wa kawnuhu lii bika aydanish tahar
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
waktub liyal yawma wa bahdal yawmi
aw mushrikin wa suuqiyaj hal zaa nafaaq
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: يَقُودُ لِى مَعَ الرِّضَى مَآ أَشْتَهِى
verses.transcription: yaquudu lii mahar ridaa maa ashtahii

verses.text: مَنْ لِّى بِهِ قَضَيْتَ رَبِّ أَرَبِى
verses.transcription: man lii bihi qadayta rabbi arabii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa qud liyal ahzama fii aghraadii
wa liya hab fil khatti wat talaawah
fii aalihi wa sahbihi zawit tuqaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: فَتَحْتَ بَابَ الشُّكْرِ لِى وَانْغَلَقَ ا
verses.transcription: fatahta baabash shukri lii wan ghalaqaa
bimam mahaa minal balaa-i wal marad
maha hisaabii wa bifawzii bil gharad
mahash shuhuudi wa taquudu lil bayaan
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
ilayka min khayrin kashiirin yaa muhabb
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
yaa man shaqan wa ahlahu yaqiinaa

verses.text: أَىْ ذِى الْبُرَاقِ حِبِّ ذِى الْحَيْزُومِ
verses.transcription: ay zil buraaqi hibbi zil hayzuumi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man salabta lii bifadlin zikrakaa
wa liya fit taawiili wat tafsiiri
wahsim fu-aadii wa lisaanii min laghaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
fii zaahirin wa baatinin yaa mughnii
lahu bihi wa suntanii han sadmati
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
kulli mafaasidi wa lil munaj mahaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
zaatii bilaa raddin wa kulluhaa sawaa
wa dararal insi wa durral jinni
wa durramaa fil ardi was samaa wa maa
warfahhu lil harshi wa lir fah zikrii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa lii taquudud dahra ahlal ghufri

verses.text: مَعَ سَلَامِِ قَدْ يَقُودُ لِى الْمُنَى
verses.transcription: maha salaamin qad yaquudu lil munaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa liya hab fii abadin tahziimah
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
maha salaamin saa-iqin maa laa yufiid
ilaa siwayaa qaa-idin lii maa yufiid
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى أَنْ لَّا يَعُودُ لِى ضَرَرْ
verses.transcription: wa habta lii an laa yahuudu lii darar

verses.text: فِى أَبَدٍ يَامَنْ يَّصُونُ لِى الدُّرَرْ
verses.transcription: fii abadin yaa man yasuunu lid durar

verses.text: مِنْ قَصْدِ ضُرِّى لَاتَسُقْ لِىَ اللَّعِينْ
verses.transcription: min qasdi durrii laa tasuq liyal lahiin
wa hab liyal yawma talaazumil yaqiin

verses.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى التَّحْفِيقَ فِى أَخْذِى وَفِى
verses.transcription: wa habta lit tahfiiqa fii akhzii wa fii
tarkii wa lii wassalta bil haadil wafii
lii judtta yaa qadiiru  bil wusuuli
laka wa bil fasli wa bit tafsiili
ilaa siwaa zaatii wa maa asaa-aa

bir ruuhi wa jasadi wal janaani
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hul bihi baynii wa baynash shakki
yaa man yuliinus sakhra misla dakki
yaa man yuraqil habda in ardaakaa

verses.text: وَاجْعَلْ فُؤَادِى زَاهِدًا فِى كُلِّ مَا
verses.transcription: wajhal fu-aadii zaahidan fii kulli maa

verses.text: هَبْ لِىَ فِى الْمَبَاحِ لِى أُجُورَا
verses.transcription: hab liya fil mabaahi lii ujuuraa
wa kulli zaalimin wa kulli haasii
aamiina yaa rabbas samaa wal ardi

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ أَوْ صَلْتُ خَيْرَ فَرْضِ
verses.transcription: yaa man lahu aw saltu khayra fardi
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa habta lil yawma wa bahdal yawmi
hismata kullii min azan wa lawmi

verses.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى الْيَوْمِ شُرُوعِى فِى الْكِتَابْ
verses.transcription: wa hab liyal yawma shuruuhii fil kitaab

verses.text: وَمَا لِىَ اخْتَرْتَ عُصِمْتُ مِنْ عِتَابْ
verses.transcription: wa maa liyakh tarta husimtu min hiyaab
wa habta liz zikra mahal halaawah
wa qudtta lit tahliima wat tilaawah
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
anhayta bayhii wa jihaadii bil huruuf
yaa baaqiyan lii kaana bimtilaz zuruuf
lahu wa lii qad salabat taqdiimaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
ghayrii wa lii khalladtta afdalal ilaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
azhabta hannii kulla shakkin wa waham
lighayri khattii wa lisaanii wal huruuf

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى بِىَ يُرِى كُلَّ شَرِيفْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii biya yurii kulla shariif
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man mahaa maasaa-anii bil hatti
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
min qalamii wa jasadii wa qalbii
halal lazii wa hab lii takriimaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma wa bahdal yawmi
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa hab lii minka talaazumil bushar
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma mubaahaatil bashar
wajhal hayaatii lin nabii khayra bushar
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: صَرَفْتَ مَا عَنِّىَ بِعْتَ فِى رَجَبْ
verses.transcription: saraftu maa hanniya bihta fii rajab
lighayri zaatii wa qudtta lil hajab
wa lii taquudu yaqanan kulla zaman
yasuunu lii makhtiira lii wad daaraa
wal bahri qaadat lii haziimal birri
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu sallaa halayhil laahu
fil aali wa sahbi wa man waalaahu

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ مَا يَصْدُرُ مِنِّى لِلْجِنَانْ
verses.transcription: fii kulli maa yasduru minnii lil jinaan
wa fil jinaani waltutayyib lil janaan
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa lil jinaani kunta lii bil af-yadi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa liya hab tayya masaafatis suluuk
yaa mughniyan hanis suluuki wal muluuk
wa an akuuna bishra kulli raa-i
wa liya hab kawnii kakulli mursali

verses.text: مِمَّنْ بِهِمْ وَهَبَ لِى خَيْرَ الْكَلَامْ
verses.transcription: mimman bihim wahaba lii khayral kalaam
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
lii abadan bighayri kaddin wa hamal
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa khayra man yanhuu lahu mahquulu
bika wa waznii lil jinaani yansalik
daaril qaraari wal munaa wal minnah

verses.text: يَامَنْ غَنِيتُ بِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ طَبِيبْ
verses.transcription: yaa man ghaniitu bika han kulli tabiib

verses.text: بَارَكَ لِى فِى عُمُرِ اللَّهُ الْكَرِيمْ
verses.transcription: baaraka lii fii humuril laahul kariim
bika wa lii taquudu ajran laa yariim
bika wa qaada lii bikar tiqaa-aa
nafayta shakkii wa hidaaya wat tuham
ilaa siwaaya lii kashafta man baham
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa maa talabtu minka yaa rabbin fahal

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى يَقُودُ لِى مَا حُمِدَا
verses.transcription: halal lazii yaquudu lii maa humidaa
yaa man bihi qabilta lii binaa-ii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
muraadahum minka wa maa faaqal maraam
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
bilan tihan yaa man ladayhil busharu
halal lazii wa habta lii mahabbatah
wa qudtta lii kawnaka lii wa khidmatah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: قَدْ حُلْتَ بَيْنِىَ وَبَيْنَ كُلِّ مَا
verses.transcription: qad hulta bayniya wa bayna kulli maa
lil khayri fil ghuduwwi wal aasaali

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِى أَبَدَا
verses.transcription: halal lazii qad haala baynii abadaa

verses.text: وَبَيْنَ كُلِّ مَنْ أَبَى أَنْ يَّعْبُدَا
verses.transcription: wa bayna kulli man abaa an yahbudaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa qudtta lii mahar ridaa sunyaakaa
wa qadtta lil ahzama fii lazzaatii
tash-hadu lii wa bizdi yaadin minka
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hul bihi baynii a baynas suu-i

verses.text: وَجْمَعْ بِهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَ كُلِّ مَا
verses.transcription: wajmah bihi baynii wa bayna kulli maa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa qudtta lid dirhama wad diinaaraa
wa liya fii kilayhimaa baarakta yaa
wa hulta baynii abadan wa baynaa

verses.text: لِغَيْرِ ذَاتِى لِى تُدِيمُ رِبْحَ سُوقْ
verses.transcription: lighayri zaatii lii tudiimu ribha suuq
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa zanni ghayrii yaa haziimal manni
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى سُؤْلِى وَمَا فَاقَ الْمُرَادْ
verses.transcription: wa habta lii su-lii wa maa faaqal muraad
bilah tiraadin wa jalawta lil maraad
bihi wa maa lam tardahu lii yaa muhiin
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَاشْهَدْ بِشُكْرِى لَكَ فِى ذَا الْيَوْمِ
verses.transcription: wash-had bishukrii laka fii zal yawmi
wa bahdahu yaa man hamaa han lawmi
aw salta lii laqqantanii fassarta lii

verses.text: لَاشَكَّ فِيمَا مِنْ عُلَاكَ جُدْتَّ لِى
verses.transcription: laa shakka fiimaa min hulaaka judtta lii
azhib bihi wa liya jud bihismah
wa mudda lii khayran bighayri sadmah
abqi liyal mulka wa hannii salliyaa
musalliman halan nabii wa kun liyaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
halal lazii wa habta lil kitaabaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَلِىَ هَبْ بِّهِ الَّذِى كُنْتُ أَرُومْ
verses.transcription: wa liya hab bihil lazii kuntu aruum
minal munaa bilaa hanaa-in yaa kariim
wa ghayri aafatin wa ghayri kadari
wa liya kun bil bishri yaa zal qadari
wa liya hab maa laa yuraa lighayrii
fil laahi waz zikri wa uzni khayri
fil aali was sahbi zawil huluumi
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: صَلِّ صَلَاةً لِّى تَقُودُ دَرْكَ مَا
verses.transcription: salli salaatan lii taquudu darka maa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma ladaa haadaatii
waktub liyal yawma wa badahu ridaa

verses.text: فِى جُمْلَةِ الْأَعْرَاضِ لِى اشْكُرْ غَرَضَا

verses.transcription: wal qawla saddid wal fu-aada nawwiri
yaa munzilan qad judtta lii bis suwari
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa habta lii yawma kitaabatii lizaa
durran wa yaa quutan adaamaa filazaa
yaa man ayaadiihi ladayya lan tariim

verses.text: عَنِّى عَلَى مَنْ بِى يُبَاهِى الْعُلَمَآ
verses.transcription: hannii halaa man bii yubaahil hulamaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man lahu minnin tahaa shukuuru
shukran wa had-yan wa wilaayatan ridaa
yaa man waqaaniyal hidaa wal maradaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
jumlata maa lam tarda lii yaqiinii
wa salli hannii abadan maha salaam
halal lazii aw rashanii khayral kalaam
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyas sidqa mahal wafaa-i
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa qudtta lii ilal jinaani fadlakaa
wa sunta lii sirriya fid daarayni

verses.text: عَلَى ابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ذِى الْبَهَآءِ

verses.transcription: wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَاحْفَظْ بِىَ الذِّكْرَ وَرُدَّ لِى جَمِيعْ
verses.transcription: wahfaz biyaz zikra wa rudda lii jamiih
makhtarta lii maha ridaaka yaa samiih
wahfaz fu-aadii wa lisaanii wa yadii
yaa mut-hifan bid duuri wal af-yaa-i
aw salta lil yawma wa qablal yawmi
wa bahdahu sirran hamaa han lawmi
wa kunta lii bin nasri wan naziimi

verses.text: حَقِّقْ لِىَ الرَّجَآءَ فِى تَرْكِى وَفِى
verses.transcription: haqqiq liyar rajaa-a fii tarkii wa fii

verses.text: لِى حَقِّقِ الرَّجَآءَ فِى كُلِّ لَيَادْ
verses.transcription: lii haqqiqir rajaa-a fii kulli layaad
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa salli hannii sarmadan wa sallimi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
kawwanta lii maa laa yuraa lighayrii
fiika wa fil qur-aani zarfil khayri
wa fii nabiyyika wa habdikar rasuul

verses.text: مَنْ لِّى بِهِ تُوصِلُ مِنْكَ خَيْرَ سُولْ
verses.transcription: man lii bihi tuusilu minka khayra suul
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
watrud bihi ibliisa tardan laa yariim
lighayri zaatii yaa hafiizu yaa kariim
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: عَنِّى عَلَى مَنْ قَادَ لِى الدِّرَايَهْ
verses.transcription: hannii halaa man qaada lid diraayah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَعَنْهُ رَاضٍ ذَا ازْدِ يَادٍ مِّنْكَا
verses.transcription: wa hanhu raadin zazdi yaadi minkaa
zidniya hilman wa ridan wa adabaa
yaa man kafaaniyash shaqaa wal wadabaa
wa suq hidaaka abadan ilaa siwaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
fassalta bayniya wa bayna maa yadurr
wa hulta bayniya wa bayna man yadurr
laka wa hamdii maadiyan biz zikri
salli wa sallim yaa ilaahii hannii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man kafaaniyal hidaa wal maradaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
liya wa dahika lighayrii kulla maa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wal jinni wa hidaa mahan wan naasi

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِى أَبَدَا
verses.transcription: halal lazii qad haala baynii abadaa
wa bayna man liya yajurru kabadaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
yaa man ladayhi kullu maa aruumu
ilaa siwaa haqdii wa qawlii wal hamal
wa lil jinaani lii yaquudaanil amal
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
bil madhi was salaati mah kalaamii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man mahaa mahaa-ibii bil hatti
yaa man widaadii lin nabiyi ballaghaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
lil harshi wal kursiyyi yaa man yarfahu
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma kamaal haqli
wa zid bihaqlid dahra ahlan naqli
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa rudda kulla maa nahaa janaabii
min darariz zufri wa durrin naabi
wa durri haynin wa kalaamin wa darar
maa haana aw yaatii wa suu-in wa gharar
ilaa siwaaya wa siwaa makhtiira lii
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
antal khabiiru wal kabiiru wal haliim
han kulli zaalimin wa kulli midffahi
wa badanii sahhih wa qalbii arshidi
akhaztta maa hanniya bihta bish shaman
yaa man wahabta lii muraadii yaa shakuur
halal lazii bihi fakakta wa lamii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa saffi lii yaqazatii wa nawmii
yaa zal baraayaa wal qadaa wal qadari
wa salli yaa rahiimu bit tasliimi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wash-had liyal yawma wa bahdal yawmi
wa hanniyaj zil muntaqaa khayran yafuuq
fil haali wal ma-aali yaa khayra rafiiq
wa hanniyaj zil anbiyaa wal mursaliin
man sarrahu bishrii khuyuuran yaa samiih
nahja nabiyyika wa zud man hasaduu
laa biqtihaamin nahyi yaa zal amri
wa salli yal laahu salaatan tuzhibu

verses.text: مَنْ لِّىَ قَادَ مِنْكَ رَبِّ خَيْرَ سُولْ
verses.transcription: man liya qaada minka rabbi khayra suul
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
lil muntaqal lazii lahu sirtul khadiim

verses.text: وَاجْلُبْ بِّهَا لِى أَبَدًا حَيْثُ أَكُونْ
verses.transcription: wajlub bihaa lii abadan haysu akuun
bilaa azan walaa jawan kun fayakuun
wa salli yaa rahmaanu sarmadan halaa

verses.text: مَنِ الْعُلَى قُدْتَّ بِهِ لِمَنْ عَلَا
verses.transcription: manil hulaa qudtta bihi liman halaa
wal aali was sahbi wa qalbii hallimi
yaa man fu-aadii wa yadii qad jahalaa
wa judtta lil yawma wa bahdal yawmi

verses.text: بِمَا بِهِ قَدْ صِرْتُ بُشْرَى الْقَوْمِ
verses.transcription: bimaa bihi qad sirtu bushral qawmi

verses.text: بِلَآ أَذًى وَلَا لَقًى وَلَا حَقَدْ
verses.transcription: bilaa azan walaa laqan walaa haqad
wa liya kunta fii jamiihil harakaat
wa qudtta lii fii jumlatil haadaati
wa salli yaa rahiimu bit tasliimi

verses.text: عَلَى ابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ذِى التَّعْلِيمِ

verses.transcription: wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man ladayka niyyatii wa qawlii
wa liya qudtta fawqa su-li wal munaa
wa fuqtu ahla harafaatin wa minaa
yaa man jahalta qalamii lii hujjah

verses.text: مِنْ أَوَّلِ الْعَامِ إِلَى ذِى الْحِجَّهْ
verses.transcription: min awwalil haami ilaa zil hijjah
yaa man jahalta liya kulla yawmi
wa lii jahalta bika kulla shahri
wa lii jahalta kulla faslin wa sanah
araytanii fadlaka fii nafsii wa fii
siwaaya yaa man saana han mukhawwifi
wan qaada lii fii hubbihi tahliimu
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
min ghayri maa yurdiika yaa muhammirii
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: لَهَا وَلَا لَهُ عَلَى مَنِ انْتَهَآ
verses.transcription: lahaa walaa lahu halaa manin tahaa
yaa man tawajjahtu lahu yaa samadu
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa qayta humriyal azaa wal kadaraa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
kashafta lii kashfan yuriinii man baham
wa suntanii hanil haadii wat tuham
yaa khayra man nuujiya bid durrin naziim
baynii wa bayna kulli man yunaazihu
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
lii abadan yaa man lahu tuwajjuhii
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
ilaa siwaaya qad zahabta bil lahiin
lil harshi wal kursiyyi fawran yurdiyaan
halal lazii lahu qilaamii wal midaad
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man bihi liya adamtal haafiyah
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa lii tukhallidur ridaa fii gharadii
wa kunta lii bimaa yudiimu busharii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyaz zakaa-a wal wilaayah
wa lii alin wa liya layyin aayah

verses.text: ذِكْرَكَ هَبْ لِى وَلْتَجُدْ لِى بِوِدَادْ
verses.transcription: zikraka hab lii waltajud lii biwidaad

verses.text: جَدِّدْ بِىَ الْإِسْلَامَ لِى اجْذُبِ الْعُلُومْ
verses.transcription: jaddid biyal islaama lij zubil huluum
an naafihaati yaa khabiiru yaa haliim
wa habta lish shuruuhu rabbis saahah
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
salli halal habdir rasuuli wan nabii
man saananii wa liya saffaa tunubii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَلِىَ هَبْ ذَكَآءَ عَقْلٍ فِى الْخُيُورْ
verses.transcription: wa liya hab zakaa-a haqlin fil khuyuur
yaa man hamaanii bil hiyaali wad duyuur
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa amsi yunsiinii biyawmii wa bighad
bilaa hidan walaa hanan walaa hisaab
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: يَاقَآئِدًا لِّى مَا حَمَى عَنْ فَانِيَهْ
verses.transcription: yaa qaa-idan lii maa hamaa han faaniyah
wa qudtta lii khayra jumaadas saaniyah
wa lii yaquudu maa yuwassihul hatan

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى مَدَحْتُ مِنْ رَّاْسِ الْحُرُمْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii madahtu min ra-sil hurum
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
lahul munaa wa qitlahu lahuq mahi
wa saananii wa saaana maafii tunubii

verses.text: رَدَّ لِىَ اللَّهُ الَّذِى كَادَ يَفُوتْ
verses.transcription: radda liyal laahul lazii kaada yafuut
minal khuyuuri maa nahaanii maa yufiit
bilaa azan wa bil munaa yarfahunii
wa liya jaada bizuhuurin wa tuhuur
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
yaa man bihi saaqa lighayril kamadaa
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa azhibi
wa qud liyad dahral haziimal ahzamaa
yaa man bihi akhzayta man tahazzamaa
yaa zaz zamaani wal waraa wal qadari
wal makri wal ghuruuri kas tidraaji
wa raa-iban taquudu lii mahal haliib
ilaa siwaa nahwii wa man asaa-aa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: عَنْ ضَيْقِ قَبْرٍ وَعَذَا بِهِ مَعَا
verses.transcription: han dayqi qabrin wa hazaa bihi mahaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
limaa yasurru kalkalii wa lij mahaa

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى بِهِ خَلَقْتَ كُلَّ مَا
verses.transcription: halal lazii bihi khalaqta kulla maa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa jud lihabdika wa hibbikal khaliil
yaa man kafaahul haara kan naarayni

verses.text: وَهَبْ لَهُ التَّوْفِيقَ فِى كُلِّ لَيَادْ
verses.transcription: wa hab lahut tawfiiqa fii kulli layaad
wa hab lahush shuhuura wal ayyaamaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
han sabrin aw hilmin wa kulli makri
kal qawli wal fihli hudaa kulliyyatii
was sawmi was salaati ahlii najji
wa lij halin nafha makaanaz zulmi
wa hab liyar raghbata han mahaasii
yaa man kafaanii durra kulli haasi
yaa man hamaanii han hidaakal mughwiyah
yaa man lahut takbiiru wat taqdiisu
yaa man lahut taqdiimu kat tamliiki
yaa man lahul khalqu kamaa lahul umuur
yaa naafihan bii kulla man yazuuru
yaa man lahu kun fayakuun yaa maliik
wa fitnatun naasi mahat wal kablu

verses.text: صَبَّرْتَنِى عَنْ كُلِّ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُ
verses.transcription: sabbartanii han kulli maa laa yanfahu

verses.text: قَهَرْتَ لِى نَفْسِى قَهَرْتَ لِى هَوَاىْ
verses.transcription: qaharta lii nafsii qaharta lii hawaay
was suu-a wal idlaala suqta lisiwaay

verses.text: سُقْتَ لِغَيْرِى كُلَّ مَا لَا فَآئِدَهْ
verses.transcription: suqta lighayrii kulla maa laa faa-idah
fiihi wa lil khayri hayaatii qaa-idah
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man saqaanii min fuyuudin murwiyah
wa qablahu wa bahdahu wash-had lii
bikhayri khayrin wa ridaaka qud lii
warfah huruufii bish shukuuri yaa shakuur
yaa khayra man naajaahu habdun bishukuur
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: صَلِّ صَلَاةً قَدْ صَفَتْ مِنَ الْكَدَرْ
verses.transcription: salli salaatan qad safat minal kadar

verses.text: مَعَ سَلَامٍ مِّنْ سِوَاكَ لَّا يَكُونْ
verses.transcription: maha salaamin min siwaaka laa yakuun
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَاحْفَظْ بِىَ الْإِسْلَامَ حِفْظًا لَّمْ يَكُنْ
verses.transcription: wahfaz biyal islaama hifzan lam yakun
yaa man lahu mahnaaya wal lafiizu
wa hab liyal hifza bilaa nis-yaani
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa han siwaa makhtarta lii yaa mughnii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَلِىَ هَبْ تَعْظِيمَ كُلِّ مَا وَجَبْ
verses.transcription: wa liya hab tahziima kulli maa wajab
tahziimuhu yaa man yaquudu lil hajab
mimmaa yasuu-unii wa maa laa ahlamu
wa qud liqalbil fayda wal ghuyuubaa
wa hab liyal yawma bighayri salabi
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
ilal ilaahi wal kitaabi war rasuul

verses.text: يَهَبُ لِى دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى خَيْرَ سُولْ
verses.transcription: yahabu lii dunyaa wa ukhraa khayra suul
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal qurba wa qawliyas mahi
samha qabuulin wa liyal khayraj mahi
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِى أَبَدَا
verses.transcription: halal lazii qad haala baynii abadaa

verses.text: وَبَيْنَ كُلِّ مَنْ أَبَى أَنْ يَّعْبُدَا
verses.transcription: wa bayna kulli man abaa an yahbudaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal hilmas sahiiha wal hamal
wa haqqi saa-imiihi hab lil mahrifah
az zikra bii muftakiran aw laafizaa
wa hab liyat tawhiida wal hadiisaa
wa hab liyat tafsiira wat tahdiisaa
wa hab liyal  buruuha fil funuuni
wa azhiril haqqa bikhattii wal lisaan
yaa man yajuudu lii bifawzin wa hisaan
bihaa shukuurii wal munaa lii tajmahu
yaa man bihi ilayka tamtaddu yadii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
liya kamaa wa habta lil wusuulaa
wa liya nawwir kulla yawmin wa sanah
yaa man tahaalaa han manaamin wa sinah
lii judtta bish shuhuuri wal hiyaani
wa tayyibin nafsa wa tayyib lil janaan
wa liya kawwinil munaa ilal jinaan
yaa munzilan wa habta lil iskaanaa
wa sunta lil jiraana wal makaanaa
han kulli shay-in bijanaabii laa yaliiq
yaa man bihamdii wa shukuuriya khaliiq
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man hamaanii han dawaahil kazmi
ahsani ihsaani wa lil munaj mahaa
yaa man yajurruz zayda wal maknuuzaa
wal qawla wal fihla minal ahlin naqdi
yal laahu yaa haliimu yaa khabiiru
yaa man bihi lam yanhunii subuuru
man darariz zufri wa durrin naabi
halal lazii wa haba lil kitaabaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa liya hab bihaqqi yawmi harafah
yaa man wa habta lish shuhuura was siniin
wa lii taquudu harafaatin wa minaa
lii bil lazii laysa yazaalu naafihaa
bilaa azan wa kabba man qalaanii
yal laahu yaa waasihu yaa kabiiru
yaa man lahul ahzamu wat takbiiru
was sidqa lii wal amna wal wafaa-aa
halal lazii madhii lahu was salawaat
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa bi hudaaka han hudaa siwaakaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: لِى أَبَدًا تَحُلُّ مَا قَدِ انْبَرَمْ
verses.transcription: lii abadan tahullu maa qadin baram
min kulli maa yasuu-u aw yadurru

verses.text: يَامَنْ بِهِ لَمْ يَنْحُ نَحْوِى ضُرُّ
verses.transcription: yaa man bihi lam yanhu nahwii durru
lahu bihi wa qudtta lii taqdiimaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man kafaanil harra bil af-yaa-i
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
zawil qilaa wan nukri haqqan afhamaa

verses.text: مَنْ مَّالَهُ فِى الْخَلْقِ مِنْ مُّجَارِى
verses.transcription: man maa lahu fil khalqi min  mujaarii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma bilas tilaabi
wa hab liyaat tajwiida bij tihaadi
wa suq lighayrii kulla man qalaanii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
makhtarta lii ladayka yaa khayra samiih
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man hamaaniyal imlaaqi wad dalaali
yaa man lighayrii saaqa laa yasjudu

verses.text: يَامَنْ لِغَيْرِى سَاقَ مَنْ لَّا يَرْكَعُ
verses.transcription: yaa man lighayrii saaqa man laa yarkahu
fis sirri wal halani wad duyuuri
yaa munzilan wa haba lii kitaabah
yaa shaahidan lil yawma bis siyaami
yaa munzilan lii jaada bit taskiini
yaa man tahaalaa han manaamin wa sinah
yaa man lahu sayriya zun tihaa-i
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa lam tuwajjih lil lazii yansaakaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
lahaa halaa musran bihi lil muntahaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa fii fu-aadil muntaqaa wa af-idah

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى لِى قَادَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَهْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii lii qaada yawmal jumuhah
maa lih tamaa lii munan wa jamahah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa hibbanaa

verses.text: هَبْ لِى سَلَامَةً وَهَبْ لِى عَافِيَهْ
verses.transcription: hab lii salaamatan wa hab lii haafiyah
yaa rabbanaa yaa zal bilaadi wal hibaad
yaa mukhziyan man raama durrii wa abaad
yaa rabbanaa yaa zal araadii was samaa
yaa rabbanaa yaa man lahul mulku mahaa
al hamdi yaa man lii munaaya jamahaa
minnii min durri hiyaalii yaa muhiin
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: مَنْ مِّثْلُهُ عِنْدَ الْوَرَى لَمْ يُعْلَمِ
verses.transcription: man misluhu hindal waraa lam yuhlami
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: لِى مِنْ سِوَاكَ وَالنَّبِى بَعْدُ أَحَبّْ
verses.transcription: lii min siwaaka wan nabii bahdu ahabb
wa habta lil ikhlaasa fit tawhiidi

verses.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى فِيمَا مَضَى مِنْ زَمَنِى
verses.transcription: wa habta lii fiimaa madaa min zamanii
maa lii yudiimu busharii wa amanii
wa zahzahul hidaa lighayrii bij tihaad

verses.text: فِى الْئَالِ وَالصَّحْبِ وَزِدْ بِىَ عُلَاهْ
verses.transcription: fil aali was sahbi wa zid biya hulaah
zidin nabiyya maa yasurruhu wa maa
yanfahuhu fiyya wa hab lil aqwamaa
wa kaana lii bikulli shahrin wa sanah
khaatabtahu fil barri wal bahri wa fii
as sirri wal jahri mahal haadil wafii
faqultu yaa rabbal waraa yaa rabbanaa
yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa yaa rabbanaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
ladayka yaa rabbi maziidun laa yariim
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa min midaadii qud lahu maasaa-aa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa min qilaamii qud lahu tabshiiraa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa min qaraatiisii lahu qudil gharad
yaa man kafaaniya hidaaka wal marad
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa qud lahu min khidamii suruuraa
yaa waahiban wa haba lii buruuraa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa qud lahu min khidamii maasarraa
yaa man kafaanii man washaa waghtarraa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَقُدْ لَهُ مِنْ عُمُرِى فَوْقَ الْمُنَى
verses.transcription: wa qud lahu min humurii fawqal munaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
laka wa jannibnil hidaa wal lawmaa

verses.text: مَعَ سَلَامٍ جَالِبٍ لِّى مَآ أُحِبّْ
verses.transcription: maha salaamin jaalibin lii maa uhibb
wa aali was sahbi wa humriyah madaa
lanaa sahaadatan wa ribhan wa sahah
yaa mughniyan qad kunta lii bitawsihah

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى بِهِ تَقُودُ لِى الْغَرَضْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii bihi taquudu lil gharad

verses.text: بِلَا عِدًى وَلَآ أَذًى وَلَا مَرَضْ
verses.transcription: bilaa hidan walaa azan walaa marad
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa rabbanaa yaa man tahaalaa han sinah
hanniya salli kulla shahrin wa sanah

verses.text: مَنْ قَادَ لِى مُخْجِلَ كُلِّ مِدْفَعِ
verses.transcription: man qaada lii mukhjila kulli midfahi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَاكْتُبْ لَهُ فِى كُلِّ مَا مِنِّى صَدَرْ
verses.transcription: waktub lahu fii kulli maa minnii sadar
yal laahu yaa ahadu innakas samad
yaa raafihas samaa-i min ghayri hamad

verses.text: صَلِّ بِحَقِّ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدْ
verses.transcription: salli bihaqqi qul huwal laahu ahad
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَهَبْ لَهُ يَارَبِّ مِنْ يَّوْمِ الْأَحَدْ
verses.transcription: wa hab lahu yaa rabbi min yawmil ahad
lahu wa zaynan yazdarii yaa quutaa
halal lazii mahal hanaa-a wal malaam
wa qaadanii ilayka yaa rabbi bikaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu yaa rabbi fil isnayni
fawqal munaa wal haaji min mannayni
yaa man ladayhi dararii qad muhiyaa

verses.text: مِنْ كُلِّ مَا بِهِ تَجِىءُ الظُّلَمُ
verses.transcription: min kulli maa bihi tajii-uz zulamu
wal aali was sahbi wa khattiya ahmadaa
yaa man lahu hibaadu wal hibaadah

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِخَيْرِ الْخَلْقِ فِى خَطِّى الْبُشَرْ
verses.transcription: wa hab likhayril khalqi fii khattil bushar
wa jud lahu yaa rabbi fis sulaasaa
yaa man bihid durra lighayri yadfahu
yaa rabbanaa salli salaatan lam turaa

verses.text: مَعَ سَلَامٍ لَّا يُرَى وَلَمْ يُرَا
verses.transcription: maha salaamin laa yuraa walam yuraa

verses.text: مِنَ الْوَرَى عَلَى الَّذِى قَدْ صُيِّرَا
verses.transcription: minal waraa halal lazii qad suyyiraa
wa sahbi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu rabbi biyawmil arbuhaa
maa fiihi kullu malikin wa bashiri
wa sahbi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَفِى الْخَمِيسِ هَبْ لَهُ فَوْقَ الْمُنَى
verses.transcription: wa fil khamiisi hab lahu fawqal munaa
wa sahbi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu yaa rabbi yawmal jumuhah

verses.text: فَوْقَ الْمُنَى مَعَ الَّذِى قَدْ جَمَعَهْ
verses.transcription: fawqal munaa mahal lazii qad jamahah
halal lazii wa haba lil kitaabaa
wa sahbi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu yaa rabbi yawmas sabti
wa kulla yawmin yaafihan min nabti

verses.text: وَهَبْ لَهُ الْأَيَّامَ مِنْ يَّوْمِ الْأَحَدْ
verses.transcription: wa hab lahul ayyaama min yawmil ahad
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
salli salaatan mah salaamin lan tihaa

verses.text: لَهَا عَلَى مَنْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَا يُشْتَهَى
verses.transcription: lahaa halaa man qudtta lii maa yushtahaa
makrin walaa hisaabin aw nahwi balaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa samadu innakal ahad

verses.text: وَقُدْتَّ لِى جُودَكَ مِنْ يَّوْمِ الْأَحَدْ
verses.transcription: wa qudtta lii juudaka min yawmil ahad
salli wa sallim sarmadan halan nabii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wash-had liyad dahra bihamdin wa shukuur
wa biridan bika hanka yaa shakuur
yaa khayra man lahu tawajjahal faqiir
wa khayra man bihi ta-annasal haqiir
wa lii atabtan nafsa kal janaani
yaa khayra man ilayhi tamtaddu yadu
lin qaada minka lil jinaanil af-yadu
yaa zal araadii was samaawaatil hulaa

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ الْخَلْقُ مَعًا يَامَنْ عَلَا
verses.transcription: yaa man lahul khalqu mahan yaa man halaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man bihi nawwarta lii janaanii
wa qudtta lii zaadan ilal jinaani
wa salli yaa rahmaanu bit tasliimi
halal lazii qad faaza bit takliimi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man bihi amrii ramamta tayyaa
wa salli yaa rahiimu sarmadan halaa
han kulli saalikin wa kulli saalikah
wa qaada bil iimaani wal islaami
wa azharal haqqa wa diinaka nasar
qalbal lazii bihaa yusallii yaa muniir
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man bihi lii qadayta arabii
wa qudtta lii bihi lisaanal harabi
wa qud lahu halaawatan wa quutaa
wa bikitaabatii lahu qud maa yaziid

verses.text: مَنْ مَّعَهُ قَدْ شَهِدُواْ مِنْ قُدَمَآ
verses.transcription: man mahahu qad shahiduu min qudamaa
bihi wa akhjaltas suyuufa war rimaah
bimaa bihi madahtuhu yaa zas samaah
yaa man hasamtanii bihi min laahi
wa liya bir rahmaani qad jalabtaa
nafhan bilaa durri wa lii ghalabtaa
wa bir rahiimi kunta lii bilaa hisaab
halan nabii wa liya kun wa hallimaa
yal laahu salli waltusallim fii abad

verses.text: عَنِّى عَلَى مَنْ لَّكَ قَادَ مَنْ عَبَدْ
verses.transcription: hannii halaa man laka qaada man habad
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa suq lighayri badanii wa ruuhii
wa suq lighayri maa hawaytu mafsadah
walaa tuwajjih lil hidaa wal hasadah
wajhal haqaa-idii wa qawlii wal hamal
khayra masaaliha wa suq liyal amal

verses.text: وَفِى الَّذِى لِىَ تُبِيحُ هَبْ لِى
verses.transcription: wa fil lazii liya tubiihu hab lii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
lii abadan wa sirtu zah tisaabi
yaa rabbi laa uhsii sanaa-an halayka
wa hulta bayniya wa baynad durri
wa judtta lii minka bikhayri sirri
yaa qaa-idan liyal munaa yaa muhsii
yaa sayyidii yaa mustafaa yaa zan nadaa
fil aali wal as-haabi wal atbaahi
yaa sayyidii yaa mujtabaa yaa zal hulaa
sallaa halayka man tahaalaa wa halaa
fil aali was sahbi wa kaffa maa hazar
hannii wa jaada lii ilayka bin nazar
yaa sayyidii yaa muntaqaa yaa zal hudaa

verses.text: أَزْكَى صَلَاةٍ لِّى تَسُوقُ كُلَّ مَا
verses.transcription: azkaa salaatin lii tasuuqu kulla maa
yaa sayyidii yaa muqtafaa yaa man saraa
sallaa halayka man dahaaka lis suraa
was sahbi man ghadan lahum ma-aalii
yaa sayyidii yaa khayra mursalin ilaa
bil aali was sahbi wa man tahabbadaa

verses.text: تُطِيبُ لِى طُوبَاىَ مَعْ دَارِ السَّلَامْ
verses.transcription: tutiibu lii tuubaaya mah daaris salaam
yaa khayra kulli waalidin wa maa walad

verses.text: صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ مَنْ تَعَالَى عَنْ وَّلَدْ
verses.transcription: sallaa halayka man tahaalaa han walad
bil aali was sahbi wa zaada madadii
yaa man litasdiiqika qad shuqqal qamar
fil aali was sahbi bilan siraami
wa kulla maa halayya hannii kaffaraa
yaa mustafaa yaa muntaqaa yaa mujtabaa
wa sahbikal ghurri wa qaada lil maraam
kaffa wa maa yahri munir tiqaa-aa
waz zikri was salaati bil halaawah
wa jaada lii bil hilmi wal ahmaali
wa bit ta-addubi wa bil kamaali
yaa sayyidii yaa bugh-yatii yaa junnatii
han kulli suu-in abadan yaa jannatii
wa liya saaqa kulla maa akhtaaru
dunyaa wa ukhraa bika zaa salaamah
wa tayyabaz zamaana lii kamaa uhibb
wa kaffa hannii sarmadan maa laa uhibb

verses.text: وَبِكَ لِى كَانَ وَسَاقَ لِى الْأَرَبْ
verses.transcription: wa bika lii kaana wa saaqa lil arab
hattaa asiira bishra hujmin wa harab
wa qaada lii bilaa hisaabinil munaa
wa hatta zanbii wa huyuubiya mahaa
wa raada lii kulla kanuudin jamahaa

verses.text: وَجَادَ لِى بِكَوْنِ ذَا النَّظْمِ شِفَآ
verses.transcription: wa jaada lii bikawni zan nazmi shifaa
liya wa lil ummati haysu kushifaa
bihi wa saaqa lii bihil mazaayaa

verses.text: إِذْ بِكَ عَنِّى قَدْ نَفَى عَنَآءِى
verses.transcription: iz bika hannii qad nafaa hanaa-ii
yaa man su-aalu ghayrihi hindii dalaal

verses.text: إِذْ كُنْتَ لِى بِكَرَمٍ يَاذَا الْجَلَالْ
verses.transcription: iz kunta lii bikaramin yaa zal jalaal
yal laahu yaa qariibu yaa mujiibu
bil aali was sahbil muzahzihiz zalaam

verses.text: وَكُنْ لِّىَ الدَّهْرَ وَكُنْ مَّعِى وَكُنْ
verses.transcription: wa kun liyad dahra wa kun mahii wa kun
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa hab liyaa
wa salli yaa rahmaanu sarmadan halaa
khayri nabiyyin wa rasuulin qad halaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma wa bahdal yawmi
hismata kullii min shaqaa wa lawmi
lighayri zaatii yaa hafiizu yaa salaam
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wajhal fu-aadii laka yaa baaqii ahabb

verses.text: مِنْ كُتُبٍ قَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ مِنَ الْأَحَبّْ
verses.transcription: min kutubin qad unzilat minal ahabb
wajhal bihi bahda salaatin wa salaam
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa khayra man naadaahu habdun bihuruuf

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ بِهِ كُنْ فَيَكُونْ
verses.transcription: wa hab liyal yawma bihi kun fayakuun

verses.text: فِى الدَّفْعِ وَالْجَلْبِ وَطَيِّبْ لِى السُّكُونْ
verses.transcription: fid dafhi wal jalbi wa tayyib lis sukuun
fii abadin wa lii muhaadiyyagh libi
yaa khayra munzilin wa khayra raaziqi
yaa haafizii yaa munzilii yaa raaziqii
halan nabiyyi war rasuuli zis sahah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ فِى الْئَالِ مَعَ الصَّحْبِ سَلَامْ
verses.transcription: halayhi fil aali mahas sahbi salaam
wa salli yaa haliimu afdala salaah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa salli yaa khabiiru anfaha salaah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa salli yaa wahhaabu sarmadan halaa
khayri khaliili wa habiibi qad halaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma khawaariqa taduum
wa liya hab jamhal lazii tafarraqaa
baynii wa bayna kulli jaalibin ilaa
innii lahu hibbun wa khillun wa khadiim
halaa siwaaya wal hudaa lii fassaraa
wan qaada lil baqaa mahal manaafihu
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa kawwini
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa salli yaa rabbal waraa wa sallimi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wal qawli wal hamali anta qaa-idii
yaa man wa habta lii ujuurar rusuli

verses.text: فِيمَا جَرَى بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَ مَنْ كَفَرْ
verses.transcription: fiimaa jaraa baynii wa bayna man kafar
qablu wa kunta lii bimukhjilin nafar
wa aalihi wa sahbihi wa hallimi
wa muslimun wa muhsinun wa udminu
wa qud bihi likalkalii wa qalamii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
kamaa bihi mahawta zulmii wal hijaab
wa judtta lii bihi bi-asanil ijaab
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
minnii wa hab lil hilma wal qabuulaa
min ghayrihaa yaa man ladayhil ahlaa
al laahi wakfinish shaqaa wan nadamaat
bahda salaatin wa salaamin wa ridaa
halayhimu hanhum wa qud lil gharadaa
wa salli yaa rahiimu bit tasliimi

verses.text: عَلَى ابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ذِى التَّكْلِيمِ

verses.transcription: wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa sallli yal laahu salaatan bisalaam
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَاشْهَدْ لِىَ اللَّهُمَّ فِى الْفَرْدِ رَجَبْ
verses.transcription: wash-had liyal lahumma fil fardi rajab

verses.text: يَامَنْ يَّقُودُ لِى بِهِ أَعْلَى عَجَبْ
verses.transcription: yaa man yaquudu lii bihi ahlaa hajab
wa han shafiihin qad azaalal kaddaa
wa annanii habdun lirabbii wa khadiim
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyar raghbata fiimaa tardaa
wa raghbatan han kulli maa laa tardaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
liya shawaahida wa rud liyal funuun
yaa man lahu zikrii wa shukrii bil hisaan
aamina yaa rabbal waraa bilaa kadar

verses.text: أَوْ ءَافَةٍ يَامَنْ بِهِ يُجْرِى الْقَدَرْ
verses.transcription: aw aafatin yaa man bihi yujril qadar
wa salli yaa ahudu sarmadan halaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa liya hab tawhiida kulli mursali
wa kulli saahibin wa khattii hassali

verses.text: مِنْ كُلِّ خَطٍّ وَإِلَى الْمَاحِى الْأَحَبّْ
verses.transcription: min kulli khattin wa ilal maahil ahabb
wa fikratii nawwir wa qalbii arshidaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab lahu lutfan jamiilan wa habi
wa salli yaa latiifu yaa ahadu yaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa hab liyal yawma bihaqqil laahi
yaa khayra raaziqin wa khayra munzili
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu ya rahiimu yaa
ilaa siwaa qalbii wa qaalabii mahaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa qud lahu khayra salaamin laa yariim
yaquudu lii minka muraadii yaa kariim
bilaa azan walaa jawan walaa marad
walaa hidan wa lii tutayyibul gharad
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
wa lii tukhallidu ilal khuldil aman
wa ahlihi yaa man habaa bil ghufri
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa lahumaa hab rabbi minka rahmah
wa sadriyaj hal rabbi manbahal huluum
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
lii war ridaa was sidqa wal amdaadaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ مَا كُنْتُ أَرُومُ جَذْبَا
verses.transcription: lii qudtta maa kuntu aruumu jazbaa
yaa man kafaaniyaf tiraa wa kizbaa
yaa man kafaaniyash shaqaa wal hasadaa

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى زَحْزَحَ كُلَّ مَنْ أَرَادْ
verses.transcription: halal lazii zahzaha kulla man araad
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa mughniyan liya yaquudu maa aruum
yaa man radiita hanhu iz ardaakaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man hamaanii han muhadin wa safar
wa qaada lii khuyuurahu minhu safar

verses.text: فِى قَلْبِ مَنْ لَّيْسَ يُمَاثِلُ الْبَشَرْ
verses.transcription: fii qalbi man laysa yumaasilul bashar
fil khalqi wal khulqi wa kisratil bushar
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa nuuruhu yaquuduhum fii kulli hiin
yal laahu yaa aakhiru antal awwalu
yaa man bihi yasfuu rabiihul awwalu
yaa man bihi yajrii bi-iznihil qadar
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa qaa-idan liz zikri kal masaanii
yaa man bihi taaba rabbihus saanii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
fis sirri wa jahri haduwwal ashqiyaa
wa lii bihi habbabtanii lil muslimiin
yaa man wahabta lii hudan daliilaa
yaa man bihi taabat jumaadal uulaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
bijaahihi yaa man bihi qad hubidaa
yaa man hamaanii han hanaa-il faaniyah
maha salaamin saa-iqin maa laa yaliiq
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man hamaanii han hidan wa tababi
wa muslimun wa muhsinun wa udminu
yaa qaa-idan lii min ra-iisil hurumi
yaa man lahu minnim tidaahu ahmadaa

verses.text: لَهُ عَلَى مَنْ قَادَ لِى مَا يُشْتَهَى
verses.transcription: lahu halaa man qaada lii maa yushtahaa
fil haali wal ma-aali wahwas sanadu

verses.text: مَنْ لِّسِوَاىَ قَدْ نَفَى مَنْ فَنَدُواْ
verses.transcription: man lisiwaaya qad nafaa man fanaduu
yaa qaa-idan lii duuna kasbin wa safar
mukhjila kasbin wa silaahin fii safar
wa ziinatin nisaa-i man mahal majaal
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa qaa-idan lii maa mahaa taqawwulaa
wa qudtta lii minka rabiihal awwalaa

verses.text: عَلَى ابْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

verses.transcription: wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa qaa-idan liz zikra wa masaaniyaa
wa qutta lii minka rabiihas saaniyaa
wa bashshiran bii zal jawaamihil kalaam
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa qudtta lii minka jumaadal uulaa

verses.text: مَنْ لِّى يَقُودُ عِلْمَ مَالَمْ نَعْلَمِ
verses.transcription: man lii yaquudu hilma maa lam nahlami
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yaa man kafaanii kulla zii shaqaa-i
wa kunta lii bil bishri wal baqaa-i
wal aali wa sahbi wa hazzim qalamii
yaa man yaquudu lii minal lawhil hajab

verses.text: صَلِّ صَلَاةً قَدْ صَفَتْ مِنَ اللَّغَى
verses.transcription: salli salaatan qad safat minal laghaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
waltahminii han kulli kaddin wa marad

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِىَ الْأَعْظَمَ فِى كُلِّ غَرَضْ
verses.transcription: wa hab liyal ahzama fii kulli gharad
yaa man habaanii bil lazii lii baanaa
yaa qaa-idan lin nafha fii shahbaanaa
tanfil hidaa mahan bisirrin wa halan
minnii wa mimmakh tartahu lii yaa muriid
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
hanil hidaa wa jannatan lil jannah
yaa man wa habta liya khayra fayadaan
wa judtta lii fadlan bishahri ramadaan

verses.text: صَلِّ صَلَاةً لِىَ تَقُودُ كُلَّ مَا
verses.transcription: salli salaatan liya taquudu kulla maa
wa yakshifaani liya kulla man baham
minka wa nawwarta bihi qalbal hakiim
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَلْتُخْرِجَنْ مِّنْ كُلِّ قَلْبِ قَدْ قَصَدْ
verses.transcription: waltukhrijan min kulli qalbi qad qasad
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu antal waalii
yaa qaa-idan lil khayri fii shawwaali
fil barri wal bahri wa lii qitlii qahar
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
bayyin lahum tab-yiina man laa yakhfaa

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ شُكْرِىَ مِنْ ذِى الْقِعْدَهْ
verses.transcription: yaa man lahu shukriya man zil qihdah

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَهْرِ وَيَقُودُ بِى السَّعِيدْ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shahri wa yaquudu bis sahiid
ilayka biz zikri wa bil hadiisi
wa habta lii bihil hudaa wal hikmaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wa azhibil lazii yuriidu kulla maa
wa suq lighayri haasidii wa alamah
yaa man hamaanii qudwatan wa hujjah

verses.text: وَكُنْتَ لِى فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَسَنَهْ
verses.transcription: wa kunta lii fii kulli shahrin wa sanah
yaa man tahaalaa han manaami wa sinah
wa lii taquudu harafaati wa minaa
wa lii yaquudu kulla khayrin yuhmadu
man qaada ghayriya lahu fan qaadaa
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: فِى أَبَدٍ لَّهُ رِضًى أَعْلَى بُشَرْ
verses.transcription: fii abadin lahu ridan ahlaa bushar
yaa man wa habta lish shuhuura bishraa
lii lii atabtahaa mahan wal hashraa
lii qudtta man jalaa wa maa takammanaa
wa lii badal bishru bi-ayyamin minaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
laka wa qaada lil hudaa wa qiilah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: مِنْ كُلِّ مَا بِهِ تَجِىءُ الظُّلَمُ
verses.transcription: min kulli maa bihi tajii-uz zulamu
yaa munzilan lii jaada bil maghaanii
mawaatinii wa lii hudaaka wa habat
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِىَ الْأَمَانَ فِى كُلِّ لَيَادْ
verses.transcription: wa hab liyal amaana fii layaad
wajhal qalaamii wa midaadii wal lisaan
yal laahu yaa zal harshi wal kursiyyi
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ يَابَاقِى الْقَدِيمْ
verses.transcription: fii kulii maa likh tarta yaa baaqil qadiim
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
hanil laqaa yaa man lahu tahsiinu
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa
hanil hidaa laka wa annii muhtirif
biz zikri wash shukri bilaa kufraani
wa aalihi wa sahbihi warfah lakaa
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: إِلَى سِوَى مَااخْتِيرَ لِى مِنَ الْمُبَاحْ
verses.transcription: ilaa siwaa makhtira lii minal mubaah
wa qaada lii khayra buruurin wa rabaah
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
wajhal mamarrii wa maqarrii wad duyuur
yaa naafiyan man laa yakuunu saajidaa
yaa man lanaa baabal jinaani fatahaa
yaa man hamaa kulliyyatii hanish shaqaa
wa ahlihi wa kulli mufdin lishaqaa
fil haali yaa muniiru was tiqbaali
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali
warfah haqaa-idii wa qawlii wal hamal
hanil azaa lii jannatan lil jannah
yal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa rahiimu yaa

verses.text: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى أَثْمَانَ مَا عَنِّىَ بِيعْ
verses.transcription: aw salta lii asmaana maa hanniya biih
wa liya kun bikaramin wa manni
wa salli hannii abadan halan nabii
wa sahbihi fil haali wal ma-aali

translations.fr: Ils m'ont conseillé :  <<Va t'agenouiller auprès des détenteurs du pouvoir (Rois)

verses.text: تَحُزْ جَوَابِزَ تُغْنِى كُلَّ مَا حِينِ
verses.transcription: tahuz jawaabiza tughnii kulla maa hiini

translations.fr: et tu obtiendras des récompenses qui t'enrichiront pour toute la vie>>.
J'ai répondu : Je compte sur mon Seigneur, je me contente de lui;

verses.transcription: wa lastu radiya khayral hilmi wad diini

translations.fr: et je ne désire rien d'autre que le savoir et la religion.

verses.text: وَلَسْتُ أَرْجُو وَلَا أَخْشَى سِوَى مَلِكِى
verses.transcription: wa lastu arjuu wa laa akhshaa siwaa malikii

translations.fr: Je n'espère qu'en mon Roi, je ne crains que Lui, qu'il est Auguste
c'est Lui qui peut m'enrichir et me sauver.

verses.text: أَنِّى أَفَوِّضُ أَحْوَا لِى لِمَنْ عَجَزُوا
verses.transcription: annii afawwidu ahwaa lii liman hajazuu

translations.fr: Comment pourrai-je confier mes affaires à des gens
qui sont aussi incapables de s'occuper des leurs que des affamés ?
Ou bien comment l'amour des vanités de ce monde m'oblige t-il à fréquenter des êtres
dont la mesure est le parterre fleuri des démons (Satan)?

verses.text: إِنْ كُنْتُ ذَا حَزَنٍ أَوْكُبْتُ ذَا وَطَرٍ
verses.transcription: in kuntu zaa hazanin awkubtu zaa wa tarin

translations.fr: Si j'éprouve un chagrin ou bien si j'ai une requête à présenter,

verses.text: دَعَوْتُ ذَا الْعَيْنِ قَبْلَ الرَّاءِ وَالشِّينِ
verses.transcription: dahawtu zal hayni qablar raa-i wash shiini

translations.fr: c'est au maître du Trône que j'adresserais mes prières.

verses.transcription: wahwal muhiinul lazii laa shay-a yuhjizuhu

translations.fr: Il est l'aide que rien ne réduit à l'impuissance
et c'est lui qui fait ce qu'il veut de la manière qui lui plaise.

verses.text: إِنْ شَاءَ تَعَجِيلَ أَمْرِ كَانَ ذَا عَجَلٍ
verses.transcription: in shaa-a tahajiila amri kaana zaa hajalin

translations.fr: S'il veut brusquer une affaire celle-ci est vite réalisée

verses.transcription: aw shaa-a taajiilahu yabtaa ilal hiini

translations.fr: et s'il veut en retarder l'échéance, elle ne sera accomplie qu'aprés le délai marqué.

verses.text: يَامَنْ يَّلُومُ فَلَا تُكْثِرْ وَدَعْ عَذَ لِى
verses.transcription: yaa man yaluumu falaa tuksir wa dah haza lii

translations.fr: Ô mon censeur qui me fais des reproches : n'exagère pas, cesse de me blâmer

verses.text: إِذْ لَسْتُ مِنْ فَقْدَتِى الدُّنْيَا بِمَحْزُونِ
verses.transcription: iz lastu min faqdatid dunyaa bimahzuuni

translations.fr: car je ne m'attriste pas de la privation des biens terrestres!

verses.text: إِنْ كَانَ عَيْبِىَ زَهْدٌ فِى حُطَامِهِمُ
verses.transcription: in kaana haybiya zahdun fii hutaamihimu

translations.fr: Si mon défaut consiste au renoncement du pouvoir des princes,
voilà un vice dont je ne rougirai point.

verses.text: قَلْبِى لَهُ فِى عِتَابِ الْجِسْمِ تَكْرَارُ
verses.transcription: qalbii lahu fii hitaabil jismi takraaru
li-annahu lil hudaa wan nuuri jarraaru

verses.text: يَلُومُ جِسْمِىَ دَأْبًا فِى الْجُلُوسِ بِلَا
verses.transcription: yaluumu jismiya da-ban fil juluusi bilaa
hilmi walaa hamalin wan nafsu gharraaru
maazaala lil khayri yadhuuhu wa yajzubuhu
wa lis sahaadati da-ban wahwa qarraaru

verses.text: يَلُومُهُ وَهْوَ فِى قَهْرٍ وَفِى كَبَلٍ
verses.transcription: yaluumuhu wahwa fii qahrin wa fii kabalin

verses.text: قَدْ عَاقَ جِسْمِىَ عَمَّا الْقَلْبُ يَطْلُبُهُ
verses.transcription: qad haaqa jismiya hammal qalbu yatlubuhu
fal yawma wajjahtu wajhii taa-iban abadan
lil laahi tawbata man adnaahu ghaffaaru

verses.text: غَفَّارُ لِى اغْفِرْ ذُنُوبِى وَافْكُكَنْ كَبَلِى
بَيْتَانِ مِنْ قَوْلِ مَنْ بِالْعُرْفِ أَمَّارُ
verses.transcription: baytaani min qawli man bil hurfi ammaaru

verses.text: زُرْمَنْ تُحِبُّ وَإِنْ شَطَّتْ بِكَ الدَّارُ
verses.transcription: zurman  tuhibbu wa in shattat bikad daaru
wa haalu min duunihi sahlun wa awhaaru

verses.text: إِلَيْكَ قَدْ تُّبْتُ مِنْ قَوْلِى وَمِنْ عَمَلِى
verses.transcription: ilayka qad tubtu min qawlii wa min hamalii

verses.text: وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتُ أَخْتَارُ
verses.transcription: wa min jamiihil lazii qad kuntu akhtaaru
minkat tajaawuza hammaa haaba aw zaaru

verses.text: كَوْنِى لَدَيْكَ كَمَنْ حَجُّواْ وَمَنْ زَارُواْ
verses.transcription: kawnii ladayka kaman hajjuu wa man zaaruu
hab lii bifadlika yaa wahhaabu yaa malikii
kawnii ladayka kaman bir ruuhi zawwaaru
aw annahu hindahum fiimaa yaraa basarun
lil badri nuurun haziimun yustanaaru bihi

verses.text: لَاكِنْ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لِّلشَّمْسِ إِظْهَارُ
verses.transcription: laakin izaa lam yakun lish shamsi izhaaru

verses.text: لِلْقَصْبِ طُولٌ لَّدَى عَيْنٍ لَهُ نَظَرَتْ
verses.transcription: lil qasbi tuulun ladaa haynin lahu nazarat

verses.text: لَاكِنْ إِذَا حَوْلَهُ لَمْ تَنْبُتَ أَشْجَارُ
verses.transcription: laakin izaa hawlahu lam tanbuta ashjaaru
yakuunu lil birri maa-un taaba mashrabuhu

verses.text: لَا كِنَّهُ مِنْ خَلِيجِ الْبَحْرِ أَقْطَارُ
verses.transcription: laa kinnahu min khaliijil bahri aqtaaru
at talun maa-un walaa kal wabli munsajiman
walaa tujaarin nadaa bil maa-i amtaaru

verses.text: ذَاكَ الْمَلَاذُ الَّذِى أَرْجُو النَّجَاةَ بِهِ
verses.transcription: zaakal malaazul lazii arjun najaata bihi
dun-yaa wa ukhraa falaytii hawlahu jaaru

verses.text: وَهْوَ الَّذِى عِيقَ جِسْمِى عَنْ زِيَارَتِهِ
verses.transcription: wahwal lazii hiiqa jismii han ziyaaratihi
laakin lisaanii lahu kal qalbi zawwaaru

verses.text: لَهُ عَلَىَّ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ دَيْنُ ثَنًا
verses.transcription: lahu halayya liwajhil laahi daynu sanan

verses.text: وَهْوَ النَّجِيبُ الَّذِى فِى وَصْفِ خَلْقَتِهِ
verses.transcription: wahwan najiibul lazii fii wasfi khalqatihi
wa khulqihi qiilata asjaahun wa ash-haaru

verses.text: وَلَمْ يَجِئْ مِنْ ذَوِى الْإِفْلَاقِ وَالْبُلَغَآ
verses.transcription: wa lam yuji- min zawil iflaaqi wal bulaghaa
bis sajhi wash shihri mimmaa haaza mihshaaru
ahlul fasaahati turran bis sanaa madahuu
wa laysa yudraku bil akwaabi tayyaaru
kahbun wa hassaanu wal buusayri qad barahuu
wa kulluhum shihruhu nuurun wa asraaru
wa annahu duunahu haqlun wa afkaaru
lil mustafaa khayri khalqil laahi manzilatun
law wujjihat nahwahaa kullal waraa haaruu

verses.text: رَامَ الْوَرَى نَيْلَ فَضْلٍ مُّسْرِعِينَ لَهُ
verses.transcription: raamal waraa nayla fadlin musrihiina lahu
wal fadlu hinda rasuulul laahi qarraaru

verses.text: بَذْلٌ وَبَأْسٌ لِّمَنْ لَّانُواْ وَمَنْ جَارُواْ
verses.transcription: bazlun wa ba-sun liman laanuu wa man jaaruu

verses.text: لَهُ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَالَمْ يَحْوِهِ بَشَرٌ
verses.transcription: lahu minal hilmi maa lam yahwihi basharun
aw jinnun aw malakun was sadru mizkhaaru

verses.text: لَهُ لَدَى اللَّهِ سِرٌّ لَّا يُطَالِعُهُ
verses.transcription: lahu ladal laahi sirrun laa yutaalihuhu
bil kaddi wal hilmi ruhbaanun wa ahbaaru

verses.text: فَالْغَيْثُ مِنْ سَكْبِ جُودِ الْبَرِّ ذُو خَجَلٍ
verses.transcription: fal ghaysu min sakbi juudil barri zuu khajalin
wa laysa ghaabin likhawfin minhu farraaru

verses.text: لَهُ مِنَ الْحِلْمِ مَالَمْ يَحْوِهِ جَبَلٌ
verses.transcription: lahu minal hilmi maa lam yuhwihi jabalun

verses.text: لَاقَى الْأَذَى فِى الْبَرَايَا وَهْوَ سَبَّارُ
verses.transcription: laaqal azaa fil baraayaa wahwa sabbaaru
lil kulli min jumlatil akh-yaari martabatun

verses.text: ضَيْقِى وَفَقْرِى قَدْ أَزَا لَهُمَا مَعًا
verses.transcription: dayqii wa faqrii qad azaa lahumaa mahan
bil mustafaa man sabquhu laa yujhalu
yaa rabbi salli halal habiibi muhammadin
wal aali wal as-haabi man qad fuddiluu

verses.text: لَكَ كَلْكَلِى لَكَ جُثَّتِى لَكَ نِيَّتِى
verses.transcription: laka kalkalii laka jussatii laka niyyatii
laka ghurbatii wa mawaatinii wal manzilu
laka malbasii wa yaraahatii mah awhihaa
wa laka midaadu wa mashrabii wal ma-kalu
hab lii idaamata maa tuhibbu wa tartadii

verses.text: فِى مَسْكَنِى طُوبَى الَّتِى لَكَ تُنْزِلُ
verses.transcription: fii maskanii tuubal latii laka tunzilu
wa ilayka qasdii raajiyan laka arhalu
bil juudi wal ikraami nihmal mujzilu

verses.text: هُوَ مَالِكِى هُوَ نَافِعٌ هُوَ رَافِعٌ
verses.transcription: huwa maalikii huwa naafihun huwa raafihun
maalikun lahu sharqun wa gharbun wahdahu
wa kazaa lahu barrun wa bahrun yukmilu
wa bi-ahli badrin rufqatii man kummiluu
mimman yukarrimu man yashaa wa yubajjilu
wa laytu han lahwin wa laghwin mudbiran
lil laahi bil qur-aani nihmal munzilu
abghii bihi wa bikhidmatil maahin nabii

verses.text: وَجْهَ الَّذِى مَنْ أَمَّهُ لَا يُعْزَلُ
verses.transcription: wajhal lazii man ammahu laa yuhzalu

verses.text: عَبْدًا لَّهُ وَيَسُوقُ لِى مَآ أَشْتَهِى
verses.transcription: habdan lahu wa yasuuqu lii maa ashtahii
naajaytuhu wa radiitu hanhu wa artajii

verses.text: هَبْ لِى الْمُنَى وَعَلَى الْوَسِيلَةِ صَلِّيَنْ
verses.transcription: hab lil munaa wa halal wasiilati salliyan
yaa man yuqaddimu man yashaa wa yufaddilu

bayts.text: رَبِّى كَرِيمٌ وَاسِعٌ وَيُفَضِّلُ ۞ وَوَسِيلَتِى عَبْدٌ لَدَيْهِ مُفَضَّلُ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Signore è Generoso, Vasto, ed Egli elargisce la preminenza; e il mio tramite è un servo (Muḥammad) da Lui prediletto.
translations.en.karamati: My Lord is Generous, Vast, and He bestows pre-eminence; and my means is a servant (Muḥammad) whom He has favoured.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Seigneur est Généreux, Vaste, et Il accorde la prééminence ; et mon intermédiaire est un serviteur (Muḥammad) qu'Il a privilégié.

bayts.text: ضَيْقِى وَفَقْرِى قَدْ أَزَا لَهُمَا مَعًا ۞ بِالْمُصْطَفَى مَنْ سَبْقُهُ لَا يُجْهَلُ

translations.it.karamati: La mia angustia e la mia povertà Egli le ha rimosse entrambe, insieme, per mezzo del Prescelto (Muḥammad), la cui precedenza a nessuno è ignota.
translations.en.karamati: My hardship and my poverty He has removed both together, through the Chosen One (Muḥammad), whose precedence is unknown to none.
translations.fr.karamati: Ma gêne et ma pauvreté, Il les a ôtées toutes deux ensemble, par l'Élu (Muḥammad), dont la préséance n'est ignorée de personne.

bayts.text: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْحَبِيبِ مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ وَالْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مَنْ قَدْ فُضِّلُواْ

translations.it.karamati: O Signore, benedici l'Amato, Muḥammad, la sua Famiglia e i Compagni, coloro che sono stati prediletti,
translations.en.karamati: O Lord, bless the Beloved, Muḥammad, his Family and the Companions, those who have been favoured,
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Seigneur, prie sur le Bien-Aimé, Muḥammad, sur sa Famille et sur les Compagnons, ceux qui ont été privilégiés,

bayts.text: أَزْكَى صَلَاةٍ مَّعْ سَلَامٍ وَلْتُدِمْ ۞ رِضْوَانَهُمْ يَامَنْ لِّوَجْهِكَ أَعْمَلُ

translations.it.karamati: con la più pura delle benedizioni unita alla pace; e rendi perenne il Tuo compiacimento verso di loro, o Tu per il cui Volto io opero.
translations.en.karamati: with the purest of blessings joined with peace; and make Your good pleasure with them everlasting, O You for whose Face I labour.
translations.fr.karamati: de la plus pure des prières unie à la paix ; et rends perpétuel Ton agrément envers eux, ô Toi pour la Face de qui j'œuvre.

bayts.text: لَكَ كَلْكَلِى لَكَ جُثَّتِى لَكَ نِيَّتِى ۞ لَكَ غُرْبَتِى وَمَوَاطِنِى وَالْمَنْزِلُ

translations.it.karamati: A Te il mio petto, a Te il mio corpo, a Te la mia intenzione; a Te il mio esilio, le mie patrie e la mia dimora.
translations.en.karamati: Yours my breast, Yours my body, Yours my intention; Yours my exile, my homelands and my dwelling.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi ma poitrine, à Toi mon corps, à Toi mon intention ; à Toi mon exil, mes patries et ma demeure.

bayts.text: لَكَ مَلْبَسِى وَيَرَاعَتِى مَعْ أَوْحِهَا ۞ وَلَكَ الْمِدَادُ وَمَشْرَبِى وَالْمَاْكَلُ

translations.it.karamati: A Te la mia veste e il mio calamo con le sue tavolette; a Te l'inchiostro, la mia bevanda e il mio cibo.
translations.en.karamati: Yours my garment and my reed pen with its tablets; Yours the ink, my drink and my food.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi mon vêtement et mon calame avec ses tablettes ; à Toi l'encre, ma boisson et ma nourriture.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى إِدَامَةَ مَاتُحِبُّ وَتَرْتَضِى ۞ فِى مَسْكَنِى طُوبَى الَّتِى لَكَ تُنْزِلُ

translations.it.karamati: Concedimi la perennità di ciò che Tu ami e gradisci nella mia dimora, Ṭūbā (Touba), che Tu fai discendere (come benedizione).
translations.en.karamati: Grant me the permanence of what You love and approve in my dwelling, Ṭūbā (Touba), which You send down (as a blessing).
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi la permanence de ce que Tu aimes et agrées en ma demeure, Ṭūbā (Touba), que Tu fais descendre (comme bénédiction).

bayts.text: عَنْكَ ارْتَحَالِى وَانْتِقَالِى رَاضِيًا ۞ وَإِلَيْكَ قَصْدِىَ رَاجِيًا لَكَ أَرْحَلُ

translations.it.karamati: Da Te è il mio partire e il mio trasmigrare, soddisfatto; e verso Te è il mio intento: colmo di speranza, verso Te io parto.
translations.en.karamati: From You is my departure and my migration, content; and towards You is my aim: full of hope, towards You I journey.
translations.fr.karamati: De Toi viennent mon départ et ma migration, satisfait ; et vers Toi est mon dessein : plein d'espérance, vers Toi je pars.

bayts.text: نَاجَيْتُ رَبًّا وَاسِعًا قَدْ قَادَنِى ۞ بِالْجُودِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ نِعْمَ الْمُجْزِلُ

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto la mia intima preghiera a un Signore Vasto, che mi ha guidato con generosità e onore: quale eccelso Donatore munifico!
translations.en.karamati: I have addressed my intimate prayer to a Vast Lord, who has led me with generosity and honour: how excellent a lavish Giver!
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai adressé ma prière intime à un Seigneur Vaste, qui m'a guidé par la générosité et l'honneur : quel excellent Donateur munificent !

bayts.text: هُوَ مَالِكِى هُوَ نَافِعٌ هُوَ رَافِعٌ ۞ هُوَ وَاسِعٌ وَهْوَ الْجَمِيلُ الْمُجْمِلُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è il mio Sovrano, Egli è il Datore di beneficio (An-Nāfiʿ), Egli è l'Innalzatore (Ar-Rāfiʿ), Egli è il Vasto (Al-Wāsiʿ), Egli è il Bello (Al-Jamīl) che adorna di bellezza.
translations.en.karamati: He is my Sovereign, He is the Bestower of benefit (An-Nāfiʿ), He is the Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), He is the Vast (Al-Wāsiʿ), He is the Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) who adorns with beauty.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est mon Souverain, Il est le Dispensateur du bienfait (An-Nāfiʿ), Il est Celui qui élève (Ar-Rāfiʿ), Il est le Vaste (Al-Wāsiʿ), Il est le Beau (Al-Jamīl) qui pare de beauté.

bayts.text: مَالْكٌ لَّهُ شَرْقٌ وَغَرْبٌ وَحْدَهُ ۞ وَكَذَا لَهُ بَرٌّ وَبَحْرٌ يُكْمِلُ

translations.it.karamati: Sovrano: a Lui solo appartengono l'oriente e l'occidente, e parimenti a Lui la terra e il mare, ed Egli porta ogni cosa a compimento.
translations.en.karamati: Sovereign: to Him alone belong the east and the west, and likewise His are land and sea, and He brings all things to completion.
translations.fr.karamati: Souverain : à Lui seul appartiennent l'orient et l'occident, et de même à Lui la terre et la mer, et Il mène toute chose à son accomplissement.

bayts.text: وَجْهِى لَهُ مُتَوَاجِّهٌ بِالْمُصْطَفَى ۞ وَبِأَهْلِ بَدْرٍ رُّفْقَتِى مَنْ كُمِّلُواْ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio volto è rivolto a Lui per mezzo del Prescelto (Muḥammad) e della gente di Badr, miei compagni di cammino, coloro che sono stati resi perfetti.
translations.en.karamati: My face is turned towards Him through the Chosen One (Muḥammad) and the people of Badr, my companions on the way, those who were made perfect.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon visage est tourné vers Lui par l'Élu (Muḥammad) et par les gens de Badr, mes compagnons de route, ceux qui ont été rendus parfaits.

bayts.text: رِضْوَانُ مَنْ دَوَّخُواْ عِدَاهُ عَلَيْهِمُ ۞ وَعَلَى رَفِيقِهِمُ الَّذِى يَتَطَفَّلُ

translations.it.karamati: Il compiacimento di Colui (Allah) i cui nemici essi hanno soggiogato sia su di loro, e sul loro compagno che si unisce a loro come ospite non invitato.
translations.en.karamati: May the good pleasure of Him (Allah) whose enemies they subdued be upon them, and upon their companion who joins them as an uninvited guest.
translations.fr.karamati: Que l'agrément de Celui (Allah) dont ils ont soumis les ennemis soit sur eux, et sur leur compagnon qui se joint à eux en hôte non invité.

bayts.text: ضَيْفٌ ضَعِيفٌ يَرْتَجِى بِهِمُ الْقِرَى ۞ مِمَّنْ يُّكَرِّمُ مَنْ يَشَآ وَيُبَجِّلُ

translations.it.karamati: Un ospite debole che, per mezzo loro, spera l'ospitalità da Colui (Allah) che onora chi Egli vuole e lo colma di riverenza.
translations.en.karamati: A weak guest who, through them, hopes for hospitality from Him (Allah) who honours whom He wills and fills him with reverence.
translations.fr.karamati: Un hôte faible qui, par eux, espère l'hospitalité de Celui (Allah) qui honore qui Il veut et le comble de révérence.
