bayts.text: وَلَّيْتُ عَنْ لَّهْوٍ وَلَغْوٍ مُّدْبِرًا ۞ لِلَّهِ بِالْقُرْءَانِ نِعْمَ الْمُنْزِلُ

translations.it.karamati: Ho voltato le spalle allo svago e alla vana parola, volgendomi ad Allah con il Corano: quale eccelso Colui che lo ha fatto discendere!
translations.en.karamati: I have turned my back on diversion and idle talk, turning to God through the Qur'an: how excellent the One who sent it down!
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tourné le dos au divertissement et à la parole vaine, me tournant vers Dieu par le Coran : quel excellent Celui qui l'a fait descendre !

bayts.text: أَبْغِى بِهِ وَبِخِدْمَةِ الْمَاحِى النَّبِى ۞ وَجْهَ الَّذِى مَنْ أَمَّهُ لَا يُعْزَلُ

translations.it.karamati: Con esso (il Corano) e con il servizio a Colui che cancella (Al-Māḥī), il Profeta (Muḥammad), io cerco il Volto di Colui (Allah) dal Quale chi si dirige non viene respinto,
translations.en.karamati: Through it (the Qur'an) and through service to the Effacer (Al-Māḥī), the Prophet (Muḥammad), I seek the Face of Him (Allah) from whom none who turns to Him is ever sent away,
translations.fr.karamati: Par lui (le Coran) et par le service de Celui qui efface (Al-Māḥī), le Prophète (Muḥammad), je recherche la Face de Celui (Allah) dont n'est jamais écarté qui se dirige vers Lui,

bayts.text: عَبْدًا لَّهُ وَيَسُوقُ لِى مَآ أَشْتَهِى ۞ وَعَلَيْهِ جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ أَتَوَكَّلُ

translations.it.karamati: come Suo servo; ed Egli conduce a me ciò che desidero, e in Lui — sublime è la Sua maestà — io ripongo ogni mia fiducia.
translations.en.karamati: as His servant; and He leads to me what I desire, and in Him — sublime is His majesty — I place all my trust.
translations.fr.karamati: en Son serviteur ; et Il conduit vers moi ce que je désire, et en Lui — sublime est Sa majesté — je place toute ma confiance.

bayts.text: نَاجَيْتُهُ وَرَضِيتُ عَنْهُ وَأَرْتَجِى ۞ كَوْنِى رَضِيًّا عِنْدَهُ قَدْ يَفْضُلُ

translations.it.karamati: L'ho invocato nell'intimità, sono soddisfatto di Lui, e spero che il mio essere a Lui gradito possa eccellere.
translations.en.karamati: I have called upon Him in intimacy, I am well pleased with Him, and I hope that my being pleasing to Him may excel.
translations.fr.karamati: Je L'ai invoqué dans l'intimité, je suis satisfait de Lui, et j'espère que mon agrément auprès de Lui puisse exceller.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى الْمُنَى وَعَلَى الْوَسِيلَةِ صَلِّيَنْ ۞ يَامَنْ يُّقَدِّمُ مَنْ يَّشَآ وَيُفَضِّلُ

translations.it.karamati: Concedimi i desideri e benedici il Tramite (Al-Wasīla, Muḥammad), o Tu che poni innanzi chi vuoi e gli accordi la preminenza.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me my wishes and bless the Means (Al-Wasīla, Muḥammad), O You who bring forward whom You will and grant him pre-eminence.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi mes vœux et prie sur l'Intermédiaire (Al-Wasīla, Muḥammad), ô Toi qui places en avant qui Tu veux et lui accordes la prééminence.

verses.transcription: wa lii yaquudu lil jinaani birraa

verses.text: يَقُودُ لِى إِلَى دُخُو لِىَ الْجِنَانْ
verses.transcription: yaquudu lii ilaa dukhuu liyal jinaan
wa fil jinaani maa tutayyibul janaan
lahu khitaabii raadiyan hanhu wa han
rasuulihi wa man qalaanii lam yuhan
wa humurih fazhu bihi yaa rabbiyaa
yaa man lahu bihi ilaahiya rukuun
liya wa lii qudttal yaqiina was sahaah
yaa khayra muhnin bif tiqaarin hubidaa
wa qaadahu liyal amiinu wal amiin
wa qaada lil ikraama wal wifaaqaa
wa ahlu badrin wa ataanis suulu
wa bil kitaabi wa rasuulil laahi
qalbii wa diihatun lirabbii wal lisaan

bayts.text: رَبِّىَ أَحْمَدُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ ۞ عَلَيْهِ خَيْرُ صَلَوَاتِ الصَّمَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Io lodo il mio Signore per (il dono di) Muḥammad: su di lui la più eccelsa delle benedizioni dell'Eterno Rifugio (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
translations.en.karamati: I praise my Lord for (the gift of) Muḥammad: upon him the best of the blessings of the Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
translations.fr.karamati: Je loue mon Seigneur pour (le don de) Muḥammad : sur lui la meilleure des prières de l'Absolu (Aṣ-Ṣamad).

bayts.text: بَرِكْ لِىَ اللَّهُمَّ فِى حَيَاتِى ۞ وَاجْعَلْ فُؤَادِى وَطَنَ الْئَايَاتِى

translations.it.karamati: Benedici, o Allah, la mia vita, e fa' del mio cuore la dimora dei Versetti (del Corano).
translations.en.karamati: Bless, O Allah, my life, and make my heart the dwelling-place of the Verses (of the Qur'an).
translations.fr.karamati: Bénis, ô Allah, ma vie, et fais de mon cœur la demeure des Versets (du Coran).

bayts.text: بَرَّاْتَنِى رَبِّ مِنْ الْإِشْرَاكِ ۞ لِى خَلِّدِ الْيَقِينَ ذَا إِدْرَاكِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai reso immune, o Signore, dall'associare (altri a Te): rendi perenne in me la certezza dotata di discernimento.
translations.en.karamati: You have made me free, O Lord, of associating (others with You): make lasting in me the certainty endowed with discernment.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as rendu pur, ô Seigneur, de l'association : rends perpétuelle en moi la certitude dotée de discernement.

bayts.text: إِلَيْكَ وَجَّهْتُ افْتِقَارِى أَبَدَا ۞ فَلْتُغْنِنِى وَلِى غِنَاىَ أَبِّدَا

translations.it.karamati: A Te soltanto ho rivolto, per sempre, il mio bisogno: arricchiscimi dunque, e rendi eterna la mia ricchezza.
translations.en.karamati: To You alone I have turned my need, forever: so enrich me, and make my sufficiency everlasting.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Toi seul j'ai tourné, à jamais, mon indigence : enrichis-moi donc, et rends éternelle ma richesse.

bayts.text: نَاجَيْتُ وَهَّابًا كَرِيمًا بَرَّا ۞ وَلِى يَقُودُ لِلْجِنَانِ بِرَّا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto la mia intima preghiera a un Donatore (Al-Wahhāb) generoso e benevolo, che con bontà mi conduce ai Giardini del Paradiso.
translations.en.karamati: I have addressed my intimate prayer to a generous and kind Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), who with goodness leads me to the Gardens of Paradise.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai adressé ma prière intime à un Donateur (Al-Wahhāb) généreux et bienfaisant, qui avec bonté me conduit aux Jardins du Paradis.

bayts.text: نَاجَيْتُ بَاقِيًا قَدِيمًا أَنْزَلَا ۞ كِتَابَهُ وَلِى يَقُودُ نُزُلَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto la mia intima preghiera all'Eterno, all'Antico (Allah), che ha fatto discendere il Suo Libro e mi conduce alla dimora dell'ospitalità (il Paradiso).
translations.en.karamati: I have addressed my intimate prayer to the Everlasting, the Ancient (Allah), who sent down His Book and leads me to the abode of hospitality (Paradise).
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai adressé ma prière intime à l'Éternel, à l'Ancien (Allah), qui a fait descendre Son Livre et me conduit vers la demeure de l'hospitalité (le Paradis).

bayts.text: يَقُودُ لِى إِلَى دُخُو لِىَ الْجِنَانْ ۞ وَفِى الْجِنَانِ  مَا تُطَيِّبُ الْجَنَانْ

translations.it.karamati: Egli mi conduce fino al mio ingresso nei Giardini, e nei Giardini vi è ciò che rallegra il cuore.
translations.en.karamati: He leads me to my entering the Gardens, and in the Gardens is that which delights the heart.
translations.fr.karamati: Il me conduit jusqu'à mon entrée dans les Jardins, et dans les Jardins se trouve ce qui réjouit le cœur.

bayts.text: لَهُ خِطَابِى رَاضِيًا عَنْهُ وَعَنْ ۞ رَّسُولِهِ وَمَنْ قَلَانِى لَمْ يُعَنْ

translations.it.karamati: A Lui si rivolge la mia parola, compiaciuto di Lui e del Suo Messaggero (Muḥammad); e chi mi ha odiato non ha trovato soccorso.
translations.en.karamati: To Him my words are addressed, well pleased with Him and with His Messenger (Muḥammad); and whoever hated me has found no help.
translations.fr.karamati: C'est à Lui que s'adresse ma parole, satisfait de Lui et de Son Messager (Muḥammad) ; et celui qui m'a haï n'a trouvé aucun secours.

bayts.text: مَلَّكْتَنِى الْكِتَابَ فَاحْفَظْهُ بِيَا ۞ وَعُمُرِى احْفَظْهُ بِهِ يَارَبِّيَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai dato in possesso il Libro (il Corano): custodiscilo dunque in me, e con esso custodisci la mia vita, o mio Signore.
translations.en.karamati: You have given me possession of the Book (the Qur'an): so preserve it in me, and by it preserve my life, O my Lord.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as mis en possession du Livre (le Coran) : garde-le donc en moi, et par lui garde ma vie, ô mon Seigneur.

bayts.text: إِجْعَلْ كِتَابَكَ مَعِى حَيْثُ أَكُونْ ۞ يَامَنْ لَّهُ بِهِ إِلَاهِىَ رُكُونْ

translations.it.karamati: Fa' che il Tuo Libro sia con me ovunque io mi trovi, o Tu nel Quale, per mezzo di esso, o mio Dio, ripongo il mio affidamento.
translations.en.karamati: Let Your Book be with me wherever I may be, O You in whom, through it, O my God, I place my reliance.
translations.fr.karamati: Fais que Ton Livre soit avec moi où que je sois, ô Toi en qui, par lui, ô mon Dieu, je place mon appui.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى قُدْتَّ الْمَصَاحِفَ الصِّحَاعْ ۞ لِىَ وَلِى قُدْتَّ الْيَقِينَ وَالصَّحَاعْ

translations.it.karamati: Sei Tu che hai condotto a me i Corani autentici (aṣ-ṣiḥāʿ); per me e in mio favore hai condotto la certezza e l'integrità.
translations.en.karamati: It is You who have led to me the authentic copies of the Qur'an (aṣ-ṣiḥāʿ); for me and in my favour You have led certainty and soundness.
translations.fr.karamati: C'est Toi qui as conduit vers moi les exemplaires authentiques du Coran (aṣ-ṣiḥāʿ) ; pour moi et en ma faveur Tu as conduit la certitude et l'intégrité.

bayts.text: نَفَيْتَ فَقْرِى لِسِوَاكَ أَبَدَا ۞ يَاخَيْرَ مُعْنٍ بِافْتِقَارٍ عُبِدَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai bandito per sempre il mio bisogno verso altri che Te, o Migliore di quanti arricchiscono, Tu che sei adorato nell'indigenza.
translations.en.karamati: You have banished forever my need of any other than You, O Best of those who enrich, You who are worshipped in want.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as banni à jamais mon indigence envers un autre que Toi, ô le Meilleur de ceux qui enrichissent, Toi que l'on adore dans le besoin.

bayts.text: زَيَّنْتَ ذِكْرَكَ بِعُمْرِىَ كَمَا ۞ زَيَّنْتَنِى بِهِ مُحِبًّ مُّحْكِمَا

translations.it.karamati: Hai adornato il Tuo Ricordo (adh-dhikr) con la mia vita, così come per mezzo di esso hai adornato me, amante e reso saldo.
translations.en.karamati: You have adorned Your Remembrance (adh-dhikr) with my life, just as through it You have adorned me, loving and made steadfast.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as orné Ton Rappel (adh-dhikr) par ma vie, de même que par lui Tu m'as orné, aimant et affermi.

bayts.text: لَقَّنْتَنِى يَامَالِكِى الْأَلْفَاظَا ۞ وَبِى تُرَقِى حِزْبَكَ الْحُفَّاظَا

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai insegnato, o mio Sovrano, le parole (del Corano), e per mio tramite elevi la Tua schiera, coloro che lo custodiscono a memoria (al-ḥuffāẓ).
translations.en.karamati: You taught me, O my Sovereign, the words (of the Qur'an), and through me You raise up Your company, those who preserve it by heart (al-ḥuffāẓ).
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as enseigné, ô mon Souverain, les paroles (du Coran), et par mon entremise Tu élèves Ta troupe, ceux qui le savent par cœur (al-ḥuffāẓ).

bayts.text: تَرْتِيلُ ئَايَاتِ الْكِتَابِ يُغْنِى ۞ عَنِ الْمَكَارِهِ بِفَضْلِ الْمُغْنِى

translations.it.karamati: La recitazione cadenzata (at-tartīl) dei versetti del Libro preserva dalle avversità, per grazia di Colui che arricchisce (Al-Mughnī).
translations.en.karamati: The measured recitation (at-tartīl) of the verses of the Book keeps one from adversities, by the grace of the Enricher (Al-Mughnī).
translations.fr.karamati: La récitation psalmodiée (at-tartīl) des versets du Livre préserve des adversités, par la grâce de Celui qui enrichit (Al-Mughnī).

bayts.text: إِنَّ تِلَاوَةَ الْكِتَابِ صَرَفَتْ ۞ لِغَيْرِ ضُرِّىَ الْعِدَى فَانْصَرَفَتْ

translations.it.karamati: In verità, la recitazione del Libro ha distolto i nemici verso altro che il mio danno, ed essi si sono allontanati.
translations.en.karamati: Truly, the recitation of the Book has turned the enemies towards other than my harm, and they have turned away.
translations.fr.karamati: En vérité, la récitation du Livre a détourné les ennemis vers autre chose que mon dommage, et ils se sont éloignés.

bayts.text: لَايَنْتَحِى إِلَى حَيَاتِى سُوءُ ۞ بِصَوْنِ رَبِّىَ وَلَا مُسِىءُ

translations.it.karamati: Nessun male si volge verso la mia vita, per la custodia del mio Signore, né alcun malfattore.
translations.en.karamati: No evil turns towards my life, through my Lord's safekeeping, nor any evildoer.
translations.fr.karamati: Aucun mal ne se dirige vers ma vie, par la protection de mon Seigneur, ni aucun malfaisant.

bayts.text: يَقُودُ لِى الْكِتَابُ مَا يَسُرُّ ۞ بِلَا نِهَايَتٍ وَلَا أَغْتَرُّ

translations.it.karamati: Il Libro conduce a me ciò che rallegra, senza fine, e io non mi lascio sedurre dall'illusione.
translations.en.karamati: The Book leads to me that which gladdens, without end, and I am not beguiled by illusion.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Livre conduit vers moi ce qui réjouit, sans fin, et je ne me laisse pas séduire par l'illusion.

bayts.text: يَسُرُّ عُمْرِىَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ۞ عَلَيْهِ تَسْلِيمَاتُ مُخْزِى لَاهِ

translations.it.karamati: La mia vita allieta il Messaggero di Allah (Muḥammad): su di lui i saluti di pace di Colui che umilia l'incurante (al-lāhī).
translations.en.karamati: My life gladdens the Messenger of God (Muḥammad): upon him the salutations of peace of the One who humbles the heedless (al-lāhī).
translations.fr.karamati: Ma vie réjouit le Messager de Dieu (Muḥammad) : sur lui les saluts de paix de Celui qui humilie l'insouciant (al-lāhī).

bayts.text: مَلَّكَنِى الْقُرْءَانُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينْ ۞ وَفَادَهُ لِىَ الْأَمِينُ وَالْأَمِينْ

translations.it.karamati: Il Signore dei mondi mi ha dato in possesso il Corano, e me lo hanno condotto il Fedele (Gabriele) e il Fedele (Muḥammad).
translations.en.karamati: The Lord of the worlds has given me possession of the Qur'an, and the Trustworthy (Gabriel) and the Trustworthy (Muḥammad) have led it to me.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Seigneur des mondes m'a mis en possession du Coran, et me l'ont conduit le Fidèle (Gabriel) et le Fidèle (Muḥammad).

bayts.text: نَفَعَنِى النَّافِعُ نَفْعًا فَاقَا ۞ وَقَادَ لِى الْإِكْرَامَ وَالْوِفَاقَا

translations.it.karamati: Il Datore di beneficio (An-Nāfiʿ) mi ha giovato con un beneficio che supera ogni misura, e ha condotto a me l'onore e la concordia.
translations.en.karamati: The Bestower of benefit (An-Nāfiʿ) has benefited me with a benefit beyond all measure, and has led to me honour and concord.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Dispensateur du bienfait (An-Nāfiʿ) m'a été profitable d'un bienfait qui dépasse toute mesure, et Il a conduit vers moi l'honneur et la concorde.

bayts.text: خِدْمَةُ خَيْرِ الْعَالَمِينَ سَلَبَتْ ۞ لِىَ الْكَرَامَاتِ مَعًا فَانْسَلَبَتْ

translations.it.karamati: Il servizio al migliore dei mondi (Muḥammad) ha conquistato per me i prodigi (al-karāmāt), tutti insieme, ed essi sono stati conquistati.
translations.en.karamati: Service to the best of the worlds (Muḥammad) has seized for me the wondrous graces (al-karāmāt), all together, and they have been seized.
translations.fr.karamati: Le service du meilleur des mondes (Muḥammad) a ravi pour moi les prodiges (al-karāmāt), tous ensemble, et ils ont été ravis.

bayts.text: يَقُودُنِى قَوْدَ الْكِرَامِ الْجِيمُ ۞ وَلِسِوَى نَحْوِ انْتَحَى الرَّجِيمُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi conduce, come si conducono i nobili, la lettera «Jīm» (ج), mentre il Lapidato (Satana) si è diretto altrove, verso altri.
translations.en.karamati: The letter "Jīm" (ج) leads me as the noble are led, while the Stoned One (Satan) has turned elsewhere, towards others.
translations.fr.karamati: Me conduit, comme on conduit les nobles, la lettre « Jīm » (ج), tandis que le Lapidé (Satan) s'est dirigé ailleurs, vers d'autres.

bayts.text: رَضِىَ عَنِّى اللَّهُ وَالرَّسُولُ ۞ وَأَهْلُ بَدْرٍ وَأَتَانِى السُّولُ

translations.it.karamati: Allah e il Messaggero (Muḥammad) si sono compiaciuti di me, e così la gente di Badr; e mi è giunto ciò che chiedevo.
translations.en.karamati: God and the Messenger (Muḥammad) have been well pleased with me, and so have the people of Badr; and what I asked has come to me.
translations.fr.karamati: Dieu et le Messager (Muḥammad) se sont montrés satisfaits de moi, ainsi que les gens de Badr ; et m'est parvenu ce que je demandais.

bayts.text: فَازَتْ حَيَاتِى بِبَقَاءِ اللَّهِ ۞ وَبِالْكِتَابِ وَرَسُولِ اللَّهِ

translations.it.karamati: La mia vita ha conseguito il trionfo per la Permanenza di Allah, per il Libro e per il Messaggero di Allah (Muḥammad).
translations.en.karamati: My life has attained triumph through the Permanence of God, through the Book and through the Messenger of God (Muḥammad).
translations.fr.karamati: Ma vie a obtenu le triomphe par la Permanence de Dieu, par le Livre et par le Messager de Dieu (Muḥammad).

bayts.text: قَلْبِى وَدِيعَتٌ لِّرَبِّى وَاللِّسَانْ ۞ مَعَ الْجَوَارِحِ وَفُزْتُ بِحِسَانْ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio cuore è un deposito affidato al mio Signore, e così la lingua insieme alle membra; e ho conseguito il trionfo con le belle (ricompense).
translations.en.karamati: My heart is a trust committed to my Lord, and so is the tongue together with the limbs; and I have triumphed with the beautiful (rewards).
translations.fr.karamati: Mon cœur est un dépôt confié à mon Seigneur, ainsi que la langue avec les membres ; et j'ai triomphé par les belles (récompenses).

bayts.text: يَقُودُنِى بِعِصْمَتٍ لِّلْجَنَّهْ ۞ مَنْ صَانَنِى عَنِ الْأَذَى بِجُنَّهْ

translations.it.karamati: Mi conduce, sotto la Sua protezione, verso il Paradiso Colui (Allah) che mi ha preservato da ogni offesa con uno scudo.
translations.en.karamati: He (Allah) who has shielded me from every harm leads me, under His protection, to Paradise.
translations.fr.karamati: Me conduit, sous Sa protection, vers le Paradis Celui (Allah) qui m'a préservé de tout mal par un bouclier.

bayts.text: رَبِّىَ أَحْمَدُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ ۞ نِعْمَ وَسِيلَتِى لِرَبِّى الصَّمَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Io lodo il mio Signore per (il dono di) Muḥammad: quale eccelso tramite è il mio presso il mio Signore, l'Eterno Rifugio (Aṣ-Ṣamad)!
translations.en.karamati: I praise my Lord for (the gift of) Muḥammad: how excellent is my means with my Lord, the Everlasting Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad)!
translations.fr.karamati: Je loue mon Seigneur pour (le don de) Muḥammad : quel excellent intermédiaire est le mien auprès de mon Seigneur, l'Absolu (Aṣ-Ṣamad) !

verses.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْمَوْلَى تَعَالَى الَّذِى رَبَّى
verses.transcription: radiitu hannil mawlaa tahaalal lazii rabbaa
fu-aadii wa aghnaanii wa akrim bihi rabbaa

verses.text: بِهِ قَدْ غَنِتُ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: bihi qad ghanitul yawma habdan lahu bihi
khadiiman dawaman lil lazikh taarahu hibbaa

verses.text: بِهِ قَدْ غَنِيتُ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدًا بِذِكْرِهِ
verses.transcription: bihi qad ghaniitul yawma habdan bizikrihi
wa hannii yakuqqul hara wan naara was sabbaa
nabaztul laghaa lil laahi habdan murattilan

verses.text: لِذِكْرٍ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ جَنَابِى الْعِدَى ذَبَّا
verses.transcription: lizikrin hakiimin han janaabil hidaa zabbaa

verses.text: وَأَنْفِى بِهِ إِبْلِيسَ عَنِّى مَتِى دَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa anfii bihi ibliisa hannii matii dabbaa
ilayhi tijaa-ii wahwa mughnin wa waasihun

verses.text: لَّهُ الْمُلْكُ ثُمَّ الْحَمْدُ وَالْحَالُ قَدْ ثَبَّا
verses.transcription: lahul mulku summal hamdu wal haalu qad sabbaa

verses.text: خَرَجْتُ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ بَاطِلٍ
verses.transcription: kharajtu bifadlil laahi min kulli baatilin
wa faaraqtu tadbiiri bihid dafha wal jalbaa
waqaanil hidaa wal harba wal bahra wat talbaa
jazaa-ii halal mawlaa biraddii zawil firaa
wa lii wajjahuu maalan bitaskhirihi salbaa
wa awdahtuhu jismii wa awdahtuhul qalbaa

verses.text: إِلَى اللَّهِ وَالْمُخْتَارِ هَاجَرْتُ مِنْ مَّلَا
verses.transcription: ilal laahi wal mukhtaari haajartu min malaa

verses.text: عِبَادَا تُهُمْ عِصْيَانُ رَبِّ أَلْوَرَى الْبَا
verses.transcription: hibaadaa tuhum hisyaanu rabbil waraa albaa

verses.text: قَدِيمٌ لَّهُ مُلْكٌ حَوَى الشَّرْقَ وَالْغَرْبَا
verses.transcription: qadiimun lahu mulkun hawash sharqa wal gharbaa
najaatii minal ahdaa-i wal bahri wal balaa

verses.text: غَرِيبًا وَحِيدًا مِّنْ حَفِيظٍ مَّلَا الْجُرْبَا
verses.transcription: ghariiban wa hiidan min hafiizin malal jurbaa

verses.text: هَدَانِى تَعَالَى بَعْدَ مَا كِدْتُّ هَالِكًا
verses.transcription: hadaanii tahaalaa bahda maa kidtu haalikan

verses.text: بِجَاهِ الَّذِى قَدْ زَيَّنَ الْعُجْمَ وَالْعُرْبَا
verses.transcription: bijaahil lazii qad zayyanal hujma wal hurbaa
unaajiihi fii sirrin wa jahrin wa artajii
salaahii wa islaahii bihil ahla wat tirbaa

verses.text: ذَلِلْتُ لَهُ لَا لِلْعِدَى ثُمَّ كَانَ لِى
verses.transcription: zaliltu lahu laa lil hidaa summa kaana lii
wa kanzi kitaabun hubbuhu yakshiful  karbaa
hadaanii bihi rabbii wa ahdii  binuurihi
izaa shaa-ahu rabbi zawil buhdii wal qurbaa
ilaahii ilaa tuubaaya qudnii wa salliman
wa jud bimtinaanin samma waltuuminit turbaa

verses.text: لَكَ الْبَرُّ وَالْبَحْرُ الَّذِى قُدْ تَّنِى لَهُ
verses.transcription: lakal barru wal bahrul lazii qud tanii lahu

verses.text: قَفِى الْبَرِّ هَبْ لِى الْأَمْنَ وَلْتُكْرِمِ الْجَنبَا
verses.transcription: qafil barri hab lil amna waltukrimil janbaa

verses.text: قُلُوبَ الْعِدَى قَلِّبْ إِلَى مَا يَسُرُّنِى
verses.transcription: quluubal hidaa qallib ilaa maa yasurrunii
wa bii bashsharil akhyaara waltaghfiriz zanbaa

verses.text: وَلُقْيَى عِيَالِى مِنْكَ يَامَنْ قَضَى الْأَرْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lugh-yaa hiyaalii minka yaa man qadal arbaa

verses.text: فَلِى كُنْ بِكُنْ رَّبِّ وَلِى وَسِّعِ الزِّرْبَا
verses.transcription: falii kun bikun rabbi wa lii wassihiz zirbaa
tafaddl halayyal yawma yaa rabbi bil munaa
bifat-hin wa faydin yukhjilul wabla munsabbaa
ilayka wa lil mukhtaari haajartu bil hudaa
wa bis sunnatil baydaa-i yaa man waqat tabbaa

verses.text: لِىَ اصْرِقْ كُءُوسَ الْقَوْمِ وَلْتَسْقِنِى بِهَا
وَوَسِّعْ وَهَبْ لِى الْمَصَّ يَارَبِّ وَالْعَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa wassih wa hab lil massa yaa rabbi wal habbaa

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ مِّنْكَ أَحْوِ بِهَا الْحُبَّا
verses.transcription: halayhi salaatun minka ahwi bihal hubbaa
azalta bihi kibrii wa hujbii murabiiyan

verses.text: لَقَدْ سُقْتَ لِى فِى الْبَحْرِ مَا كُنْتُ أَرْتَجِى
verses.transcription: laqad suqta lii fil bahri maa kuntu artajii
bijaahil lazii sayyartahul khilla wal hibbaa

verses.text: مَحَوْتَ بِهِ عَيْبِى فَقُدْنِى مِنَ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: mahawta bihi haybii faqudnii minal hidaa

verses.text: إِلَى إِخْوَتِى وَاجْعَلْ رُجُوعِى لَنَا طِبَّا
verses.transcription: ilaa ikhwatii wajhal rujuuhii lanaa tibbaa

verses.text: أَجَرْتَ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ يَرْجُو إِجَارَةً
verses.transcription: ajartal lazii qad kanaa yarjuu ijaaratan
fazidhul hudaa wal hilma wal takfihil hujbaa

verses.text: هَدَيْتَ الَّذِى قَدْ كَانَ يُرْدِيهِ جَهْلَهُ
verses.transcription: hadaytal lazii qad kaana yurdiihi jahlahu
fahanhuk shifil astaara yaa rabbii wal hujbaa
lakash shuqru war ridwaanu wal hamdu sarmadan

verses.text: وَلَاشَكَّ لِى فِى كَوْنِكَ اللَّهَ وَالرَّبَّا
verses.transcription: walaa shakka lii fii kawnikal laaha war rabbaa
hajartul laghaa biz zikri wash shukri musniyan

verses.text: عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى مَنْ جُودُهُ نَحْوِىَ انْصَبَّا
verses.transcription: halal mustafaa man juuduhu nahwiyan sabbaa
ayal laahu yaa rahmaanu yaa man aghastanii

verses.text: فَصَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى خَيْرِ مَنْ لَّبَّى
verses.transcription: fasalli bitasliimin halaa khayri man labbaa
wa siqtu wa kun lii bil muqaffaa wa aalihi

verses.text: وَأَصْحَابِهِ مَنْ أَخْجَلُواْ اللَّيْثَ إِذْ قَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa as-haabihi man akhjalul laysa iz qabbaa

verses.text: أُنِيلُواْ ثَوَابَ اللَّهِ فِى كُلِّ غَزْوَةٍ
verses.transcription: uniiluu sawaabal laahi fii kullii ghazwatin
mahal hubbi wa ridwaani wal qurbi wal qurbaa
halayhim minal mawlaa ridaa-un wa rahmatun
kamaa zahzahuu hannii bi as-yaafihim taghbaa

verses.text: لِىَ اجْعَلْ بِهِمْ يَا مَالِكِى خَيْرَ مَخْرَجٍ
verses.transcription: liyajhal bihim yaa maalikii khayra makhrajin
wa tayyib wa sallim wam nunan waltazid raghbaa

verses.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِهِمْ مَّعًا
verses.transcription: lahuktub salaatan mah sallamin bihim mahan

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِى بِهِمْ يَا مَالِكِى الطَّىَّ وَالْجَذْبَا
verses.transcription: wa hab lii bihim yaa maalikit tayya wal jazbaa
wa jannibniyal ihjaaba wal kibra wal kizbaa
inilnii karaamaatin wa kun lii bilan tihaa

verses.text: بِمَا فَاقَ ظَنِّى وَلْتُسَخِّرْ لِىَ الصَّعْبَا
verses.transcription: bimaa faaqa zannii wal tusakhkhir liyas sahbaa
madadttu yadii yaa maalikii raajiyan lakum

verses.text: نَفَيْتَ الْأَذَى عَنِّى فَجُدْ لِى بِأَوْبَتِى
verses.transcription: nafaytal azaa hannii fajud lii bi-awbatii

verses.text: سَرِيعًا بِلَا كَدٍّ وَلِى وَسِّعِ اللَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: sariihan bilaa kaddin wa lii wassihil lahbaa

verses.text: لَكَ الشُّكْرُ إِذْ صَيَّرْ تَنِى خَادِمَ النَّبِى
verses.transcription: lakash shukru iz sayyar tanii khaadiman nabii

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةٌ مِّنْكَ تُعْلِى بِهَا الصَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: halayhi salaatun minka tuhlii bihas sahbaa
dahawtuka bil mukhtaari bil aali kullihim
wa as-haabihi yaa man kafaanii bihim shisbaa

verses.text: نَفَيْتَ بِهِمْ عَنِّى الْأَذَى ثُمَّ كُنْتَ لِى
verses.transcription: nafayta bihim hannil azaa summa kunta lii

verses.text: فَلِى طَيِّبِ الرُّجْعَى وَلِى خَلِّدِ الْخِصْبَا
verses.transcription: falii tayyibir rujhaa wa lii khallidil khisbaa
kafayta zawit tasliisi hannii wa adbaruu
furadii wa masnii wakfiniihim bihim da-baa

verses.text: لَهُ اكْتُبْ صَلَاةً مَّعْ سَلَامٍ بِئَالِهِ

verses.transcription: wa as-haabihi wajhal bihi masjidi rahbaa

verses.text: دُعَآءٍ فَبَشِّرْ مَنْ أَطَالُواْ لِىَ النَّحْبَا
verses.transcription: duhaa-in fabashshir man ataaluu liyan nahbaa

verses.text: عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لِّى اسْتَجِبْ وَالْفِنِى النَّكْبَا
verses.transcription: halaa kulli shay-in lis tajib wal finiin nakbaa
wa khallid quyuudaati walaa tatrukis sakbaa
fu-aadii wa jusmaanii wa lii yaqbalul kisbaa

verses.text: أُدِيمُ لَهُ مَاعِشْتُ إِنْ شَآ عِبَادَةً
verses.transcription: udiimu lahu maa histu in shaa hibadatan
wa arjuu qabuulan minhu qad tuurisul wisbaa
jahaltu kitaabal laahi wirdii wa abtaghii

verses.text: بِتَرْتِيلِهِ مَا شِأْتُ إِصَارَ لِى أَبَّا
verses.transcription: bitartiilihi maa si-tu isaara lii abbaa

verses.text: وَإِنِّى إِلَى قَوْمِى أَءُوبُ بِهِ أَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa innii ilaa qawmii a-uubu bihi abbaa

verses.text: لِرَبِّىَ أَحْمَدِى ثُمَّ شُكْرِ بِلَا انْتِهًا
verses.transcription: lirabbiya ahmadii summa shukri bilan tihan

verses.text: عَلَى جَعْلِ صَدْرِ ظَرْفَ ءَايَاتِهِ حِزْبَا
verses.transcription: halaa jahli sadri zarfa aayaatihi hizbaa

verses.text: لَهُ جَلَّ شُكْرِى بَعْدَ حَمْدِ وَكَانَ لِى
verses.transcription: lahu jalla shukrii bahda hamdi wa kanaa lii

verses.text: وَلِى رَاضَ أَعْدَآءً نَحَوْا جَانِبِى حِزْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lii raada ahdaa-an nahaw jaanibii hizbaa

verses.text: نَجَوْتُ بِحِفْظِ اللَّهِ مِنْ سَطْوَةِ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: najawtu bihifzil laahi min satwatil hidaa

verses.text: وَلِى رَاضَهُمْ طُرًا وَلِى كَرَّمَ الْجَنْبَا
verses.transcription: wa lii raadahum turran wa lii karramal janbaa

verses.text: أَغَاثَنِىَ الْحَنَّانُ مِنْ كَيْدِ مَنْ قَلَى
verses.transcription: aghaasaniyal hannaanu min kaydi man qalaa

verses.text: وَصَارَ كَنَارِ الْخِلِّ لِى بَحْرُ مَايُنبَا
verses.transcription: wa saara kanaaril khilli lii bahru maayunbaa
midaadii wa aqlaamii wa lawhii wa kalkalii

verses.text: وَجِسْمِى لِمَنْ لِّى وَجَّهَ الْحِفْظَا وَالْوَهْبَا
verses.transcription: wa jismanii liman lii wajjahal hifzaa wal wahbaa

verses.text: نَوَيْتُ لَهُ شُكْرًا كَثِيرًا كَمَا حَمَى
verses.transcription: nawaytu lahu shukran kasiiran kamaa hamaa
janaabii wa astakfiihi yawmal jawal lahbaa

verses.text: لَهُ جَلَّ شُكْرِى إِذْ هَدَانِى بِفَضْلِهِ
verses.transcription: lahu jalla shukrii iz hadaanii bifadlihi

verses.text: وَجَاهِ الَّذِى مَدْحِى لَهُ صَارَ لِى عَضْبَا
verses.transcription: wa jaahil lazii madhii lahu saara lii hadbaa

verses.text: دَعَانِى إِلَى دَارِ السَّلَامِ الَّتِى بِهَا
verses.transcription: dahaanii ilaa daaris salaamil latii bihaa
unaajiihi biz zikril lazii tayyabal qalbaa

verses.text: وَأَبْغِى نَجَاةً مِّنْهُ مِنْهُ مَتِى دَبَّا
verses.transcription: wa abghii najaatan minhu minhu matii dabbaa
shukuukan wa waswaasan wa hannil hidaa zabbaa

verses.text: عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى الْمَاحِى الَّذِى اخْتَارَهُ حِبَّا
verses.transcription: halal mustafal maahil lazikh taraahu hibbaa
salaatun wa tasliimun halal mustafan nabii

verses.text: مَعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مِمَّنْ نَّفَى الْخِبَّا
verses.transcription: mahal aali wal as-haabi mimman nafal khibbaa
wa as-haabihi rabbun hafiizun kafaa tabbaa
ilayhi makaatiibii wa akrim bihi rabbaa

verses.text: يَّسُوقُ بِهِ لِى مَااعْتَمَى لِى كَمَا رَبَّى
verses.transcription: yasuuqu bihi lii mahtamaa lii kamaa rabbaa
rumnaa shukuural lazii bil kaafi wan nuuni
maashaa-a yafhalu min baadin wa maknuuni
bil laahi jalla huwar rahmaanu muqtadiran

verses.text: بِهِ غَنِيتُ عَنِ الْأَرْبَابِ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: bihi ghaniitu hanil arbaabi fii abadin
wa artajii minhu ajran ghayra mamnuuni
ilayhi qad tubtu zaa bayhin wa zahzahanii
hanil manaahii wa han afhaali majnuuni

verses.text: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِى لَهُ بِالذِّكْرِ ذَا خِدَمٍ
verses.transcription: wajjahtu wajhii lahu biz zikri zaa khidamin

verses.text: بِهَا وَلِى سَاقَ مَا قَدْ فَاقَ مَظْنُونِ
verses.transcription: bihaa wa lii saaqa maa qad faaqa maznuuni

verses.text: عَنْ نَّافِعٍ قَادِرٍ بَرٍّ رَّضِيتُ هُنَا
verses.transcription: han naafihin qaadirin  barrin radiitu hunaa
wa jaada lii bihaziizin minhu madnuuni

verses.text: وَقَبْلُ أَنْقَذَ ذَا الْوَادِى وَذَا النُّونِ
verses.transcription: wa qablu anqaza zal waadii wa zan nuuni
yal laahu yaa hayyu yaa qayyumu khuzbiyadii

verses.text: نَاجَيْتُكَ الْيَوْمَ يَامَنْ كُنْتَ لِى كَرَمًا
verses.transcription: naajaytukal yawma yaa man kunta lii karaman

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْكَريمُ الَّذِى تُعْطِى بِلَا سَبَبٍ
verses.transcription: antal kariimul lazii tuhtii bilaa sababin
yaa khayra shaaqin shafaa kullii bitahsiini

verses.text: شَفَيْتَنِى الْعَامَ فَاقْبَلْ مَا شَكَرْتُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: shafaytanil haama faqbal maa shakartu bihi

verses.text: إِذْ طَابَتِ النُّونُ قَبْلَ الْفَآءِ وَالسِّينِ
verses.transcription: iz taabatin nuunu qablal faa-i was siini
yaa man hanil haari tahmiinii wa tunjiinii
lii rudtumu ahla zaqqumin wa sijjiini
wa akhrajuunii kamaa suurin wa masjuuni
hannii furaadii wa masnii adbaruu wahumu
sumun wa bukmun wa hum-yun kash shayaatiini
yaa maalikal mulki yaa rabbas salaatiini
tanfiihimud dahra han durrii wa tansurunii
bihim halayhim wa fawqas su-li tuhtiini

verses.text: كَتَبْتُ فِى الْبَحْرِ أَنِّى لَآ أَمُدُّ يَدِى
verses.transcription: katabtu fil bahri annii laa amuddu yadii
ilan nasaaraa habiidil maa-i wat tiini

verses.text: إِنْ شَآءَهُ مَنْ بِهِ أَبْغِى السُّكُونَ بِهِ
verses.transcription: in shaa-ahu man bihi abghis sukuuna bihi
dunyaa wa ukhraa bitashiihin wa tawtiini

verses.text: لِلَّهِ جَلَّ يَدِى وَالْقَلْبُ مَعْ بَدَنِى
verses.transcription: lil laahi jalla yadii wal qalbu mah badanii

verses.text: وَسَاقَ لِى فَوْقَ مَا عِنْدَ السُّلَيْطِينِ
verses.transcription: wa saaqa lii fawqa maa hindas sulaytiini

verses.text: لِى رَضَ فِى الْبَحْرِ أَعْدَآءِى وَلِى الْتَزَمُواْ
verses.transcription: lii rada fil bahri ahdaa-ii wa lil tazamuu

verses.text: وَالْكُلُّ فِيمَا مَضَى قَدْ كَانَ يُعْطِينِ
verses.transcription: wal kullu fiimaa madaa qad kaana yuhtiini
tawajjuhii lil lazii mahmash takaytu lahu

verses.text: أَشْكَى وَلِى قَادَ مَآ أَهْوَى بِتَكْوِينِ
verses.transcription: ashkaa wa lii qaada maa ahwaa bitakwiini

verses.text: يَقُودُ لِى كُلَّمَآ أَهْوَى بِلَا سَبَبٍ
verses.transcription: yaquudu lii kullamaa ahwaa bilaa sababin
akrim bihi wa bikhayrish shukri yuh-yiini
ahaazanii wa hamaanii min hidaaya mahan
wa min mariidin rajiimin kaada yughwiini

verses.text: نِعْمَ الْعَفِيظُ الَّذِى مَهْمَى اسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: nihmal hafiizul lazii mahmas tajartu bihi
wa bil hudaa jaada lii haqqan bitab-yiini
wa lii yuhayyinu khayran kulla tah-yiini
tawjjahal qalbu minnii bish shukuuri lahu
wa jaada lii minhu takriiman bimakhzuuni

verses.text: لِى هَبْ بِّكَوْنِكَ وَهَّابًا مُّنَاىَ مَعًا
verses.transcription: lii hab bikawnika wahhaaban munaaya mahan
yal laahu yaa barru yaa rahmaanu suq gharadii

verses.text: مَاعِشْتُ لِى دُونَ كَسْبٍ غَيْرَ مَحْزُونِ
verses.transcription: maahishtu lii duuna kasbin ghayra mahzuuni

verses.text: يَاخَيْرَ بَرٍّ رَّحِيمٍ هَبْ لِعَبْدِكَ ذَا
verses.transcription: yaa khayra barrin rahiimin hab lihabdika zaa
an laa yuhaasaba fii yawmil mawaaziini
halan nabii salli bit tasliimi bil hunafaa
yaa man kafaanii haduwwan kaada yukhziini

verses.text: لَكَ الثَّنَآ وَالرِّضَى وَالشُّكْرُ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: lakas sanaa war ridaa wash shukru fii abadin
yaa khayra rabbin murabbin qad yuraqqiini

verses.text: أَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ الَّذِى فِى الْقَلْبِ مُنْكَتِمٌ
verses.transcription: ashkuu ilaykal lazii fil qalbi munkatimun

verses.text: وَجِّهْ إِلَىَّ الَّذِى أَرْجُو بِلَا كُلَفٍ
verses.transcription: wajjih ilayyal lazii arjuu bilaa kulafin
antal qadiirul lazii laa shay-a yuhjizuhu

verses.text: لِى رُضْ  بِقَهْرِكَ مَنْ قَدْ ثَلَّثُواْ صَمَدًا
verses.transcription: lii rud biqahrika man qad sallasuu samadan
summan wa bukman wa hum-yan kal majaaniini
dahawtukal yawma yaa qahhaaru yaa malikii
yaa man shukuurii lahu wal hubbu yudniini
yaa khayra mughnin ghanniyyin laa shariika lahu
fil mulki wal hamdi yunjiinii wa yughniini

verses.text: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ يَامَنْ جَلَّ عَنْ وَّلَدٍ
verses.transcription: yaa maalikal mulki yaa man jalla han waladin

verses.text: رُّضْ لِى ذَوِى الْفِصْحِ طُرًا وَالسَّعَانِينِ
verses.transcription: rud lii zawil fis-hi turran was sahaaniini

verses.text: أَجِبْ دُعَآءِى بِمَا فَاقَ الظُّنُونَ هُنَا
verses.transcription: ajib duhaa-ii bimaa faaqaz zunuuna hunaa

verses.text: نَجَوْتُ مِنْ فِتَنِ الْأَعْدَآءِ إِذْ قَصَدُو
verses.transcription: najawtu min fitanil ahdaa-i iz qasaduu
nii bil madaafihi turran was sakaakiini
anabtu iz waajahuunii bil azaa lakumu
wa rudtumul kulla lii mislal masaakiini
halan nabii salli bitasliimi bil kuramaa

verses.text: مُدَّ الْحَيَاتَ بِمَا تَرْضَاهُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ
verses.transcription: muddal hayaata bimaa tardaahu min hamalin
salaatu barrin rahiimin bis salaami mahan

verses.text: عَلَى الَّذِى قَدْ كَفَانَا كُلَّ تَخْمِينِ
verses.transcription: halal lazii qad kafaanaa kulla takhmiini
muhammadin man bibishrin jaa wa taamiini
lil laahi aqbaltu wal mukhtaaru waasitatii
wa artajii hawza ghasii khayra tasmiini

verses.text: حَاجِى لَدَى اللَّهِ بِالْمُخْتَارِ قَدْ قُضِيَتْ
verses.transcription: haajii ladal laahi bil mukhtaari qad qudiyat

verses.text: إِنْ كُنْتُ ذَا وَطَرٍ أَوْ كُنْتُ ذَا وَجَلٍ
verses.transcription: in kuntu zaa watarin aw kuntu zaa wajalin
tawajjuhii lil lazii yuhlil maqaama bilaa

verses.text: رَبٌّ يَجُودُ بِطَىٍّ قَدْ يَقِى كُلَفًا
verses.transcription: rabbun yajuudu bitayyin qad yaqii kulafan
kamaa yunajjii bilaa sayfin wa tahsiini

verses.text: ضِفْتُ الْكَرِيمَ الَّذِى يُقْرِى بِكُنْ وَّلَهُ
verses.transcription: diftul kariimal lazii yuqrii bikun wa lahu
hamdii wa shukrii wa fid daarayni yuhliini

verses.text: وَرَاضَ لِى كُلَّ قِتْلٍ كَانَ يَقْلِينِ
verses.transcription: wa raada lii kulla qitlin kaana yaqliini

verses.text: إِلَى مُرَادِى دَوَامًا كُلَّ مَا حِينِ
verses.transcription: ilaa muraadii dawaaman kulla maa hiini
wajjahtu bish shukri wajhii lil kariimi wa lii

verses.text: يَسْعَدْ هِىَ الدَّارُ دَارُ الْحَقِّ وَالدِّينِ
verses.transcription: yas-had hiyad daaru daarul haqqi wad diini
wa kawnahu liya yawmal hashri wad diini
lil laahi aqbaltu bil mukhtaari zaa khidamin

verses.text: وَقَدْ كَفَانِى بِهِ مَا كَادَ يُرْدِينِ
verses.transcription: wa qad kafaanii bihi maa kaada yurdiini

verses.text: نَوَيْتُ شَكْرَكَ فِى ذَا الْيَوْمِ يَاصَمَدِى
verses.transcription: nawaytu shukraka fii zal yawmi yaa samadii

verses.text: يَاللَّهُ ذَا الْعَيْنِ قَبْلَ الرَّآءِ وَالشِّينِ
verses.transcription: yal laahu zal hayni qablar raa-i wash shiini

verses.text: يَامَنْ يُّكَوِّنُ مَاقَدْ شَآ بِلَا سَبَبٍ
verses.transcription: yaa man yukawwinu maa qad shaa bilaa sababin

verses.text: كَوِّنْ مُّرَادِى وَلِى رُضْ مَا يُخَشِّينِ
verses.transcription: kawwin muraadii wa lii rud maa yukhashshiini

verses.text: بِالطَّىِّ وَالْجَذْبِ هَبْ لِى السُّؤْلَ دُونَ عَنًا
verses.transcription: bit tayyi wal jazbi hab lis su-la duuna hanan
yaa khayra mughnin murabbin qad yukhalliini
rabbaytanii faltuwassih lii hunaa wa ghadan

verses.text: بِلَا حِسَابٍ وَكُنْ لِّى إِذْ تُحَلِّينِ
verses.transcription: bilaa hisaabin wa kun lii iz tuhalliini
habawtanii bil lazii qad faaqa matlabatii

verses.text: مِنِّى تَقَبَّلْ وَزِدْ شُكْرِى وَزِدْ مَدَدِى
verses.transcription: minnii taqabbal wa zid shukrii wa zid madadii
tawajjuhii lil lazii tardaahu min hamalin
wa min maqaalin wa kullas suu-i takfiini
kafaytanii zama-an wal hur-ya ma saghabin
wa bil kitaabil lazii anzalta tashfiini

verses.text: فَجِّرْ يَنَابِيعَ مَآءِ الْغَيْبِ فِى خَلَدِى
verses.transcription: fajjir yanaabiiha maa-il ghaybi fii khaladii
yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halaa sanadii
wal aali mah sahbihi shummil haraaniini
halayhi salli wa sallim bil jamiihi wa qud

verses.text: نِى لِلْبَقِيعِ الَّذِى ابْتَدَا ابْنُ مَظْعُونِ
verses.transcription: nii lil baqiihil lazib tadabnu mazhuuni

verses.text: بِالطَّىِّ جُدْ لِى وَرَضْ لِى كُلَّ ذِى حَسَدٍ
verses.transcription: bi tayyi jud lii wa rud lii kulla zii hasadin

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ الَّذِى نَجَّيْتَ مِنْ غَرَقٍ
verses.transcription: antal mujiibul lazii najjayta min gharaqin

verses.text: دَعَاكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَادَاتِى فَكُنْتَ لَهُمْ
verses.transcription: dahaaka min qablu saadaatii fakunta lahum
falis tajib yaa mujiiban kulla mamhuuni

verses.text: كَوِّنْ جَمِيعَ الَّذِى أَهْوَاهُ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: kawwin jamiihal lazii ahwaahu fii abadin
bikun wa rud liya ahdaa-ii bitamriini

verses.text: إِنِّى لَعَبْدٌ خَدِيمٌ صِرْتُ ضَيْفَكَ يَا
verses.transcription: innii lahabdun khadiimun sirtu dayfaka yaa
rabbii wa bil hitqi wal itlaaqi tuqriini

verses.text: لِى كُنْ بِكُنْ سَرْمَدًا وَاجْعَلْ مَسِيرِىَ ذَا
verses.transcription: lii kun bikun sarmadan wajhal masiiriya zaa
jawfal faraa lil waraa mislal mahaariini

verses.text: صَرَفْتُ حَاجِى لِمَنْ يَّقْضِى الْجَمِيعَ بِكُنْ
verses.transcription: saraftu haajii liman yaqdil jamiiha bikun
wa atawassalu bil mamduuhi fin nuuni
ahlal baraayaa wa akhshaahaa wa akramihaa

verses.text: عِنْدَ الَّذِى جَادَ لِى بِالْمِيمِ وَالنُّونِ
verses.transcription: hindal lazii jaada lii bil miimi wan nuuni
liman kasaanii wa rawwaanii wa at-hamanii
yaraahatii shaakiran kal lawhi wan nuuni
hubbii wa wuddii wa ridwaanii wa mahmadatii

verses.text: لِمَنْ حَبَانِى بِمَا قَدْ فَاقَ مَظْنُونِ
verses.transcription: liman habaanii bimaa qad faaqa maznuuni
yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin bilaa hadadin

verses.text: وَكُنْ بِكُنْ لِّىَ فِى بَادٍ وَمَكْنُونِ
verses.transcription: wa kun bikun liya fii baadin wa maknuuni

translations.fr: Sept (versets) empêchent l'ouverture des portes de tout feu (d'ici bas et dans l'au-delà)
et ils attirent de substantiels dons en pièces d'or et d'argent.
A quiconque sait y réfléchir et imiter ils sont utiles en ce sens
qu'ils lui apportent les trésors de ce monde et de l'autre.
Ils ferment les sept portes de l'enfer,
ils sont profitables à tout être qui sait méditer.
Ils font se réaliser tout souhait utile

verses.transcription: likulli man yahdii wa yasta fiidu

translations.fr: à tout guide et à tout élève.
Ils chassent le maudit Satan loin de leur lecture
grâce au guide qui ne cesse d'aider les autres.
Ils font accueillir le savoir et accomplir de bonnes oeuvres,
ils sont bons pour ceux qui sollicitent des faveurs et qui espèrent en recevoir.
Ils aident leur lecteur à réaliser ces désirs,
ils assurent le salut aux fils comme aux épouses.

verses.transcription: takfil hidaa wal juuhal wal wabaa-aa

translations.fr: Ils protègent contre les ennemis,
contre la faim et contre les épidémies.
Ils renforcent le rendement des facultés intellectuelles.
Ils repoussent le mal loin de quiconque le récite continuellement et éloigne les illusions et les risques.
Ils facilitent l'obtention de ce qui est difficile à se procurer

verses.transcription: fii kulli baa-ihin a tahdii lis sawaab

translations.fr: et ils multiplient les bonnes récompenses dans tout acte permis. Ils mettent dans la droiture et donnent raison.

verses.transcription: taquudu man laa zamahaa lil khayri

translations.fr: Ils font obtenir ce qui bon à leur lecteur
de même qu'ils sauvent de tous les malheurs.
Ils ouvrent les portes du paradis.
Ils honorent la personne qui les récite et la font respecter.

verses.transcription: tajuudu bish shifaa-i min kulli marad

translations.fr: Ils apportent un remède à toute maladie
de même qu'ils apportent la satisfaction des désirs de leur lecteur.
Ils déjouent les plans machiavéliques des trompeurs.
Ils apportent à leur lecteur la meilleure récompense et le meilleur gain.
Ils multiplient l'abondance des pays.

verses.text: مَنْ رَّامَ أَنْ يَّظْلِمَ حِزْبَ الْفَرْدِ
verses.transcription: man raama an yazlima hizbal fardi

translations.fr: Ils exterminent ceux qui tentent d'opprimer le parti de l'Unique.

verses.transcription: taquudu man yaqra uhaa lil munyah

translations.fr: Ils conduisent leur lecteur à réaliser son rêve.

verses.transcription: wa lil hulaa tukhri juhu min mir-yah

translations.fr: Ils le portent loin de l'orgueil vers l'idéal.
Ils musèlent les malfaisants
et empêchent la mévente pour le commerçant.
Ils illuminent le coeur de tout vertueux,
et lui attirent le salaire et le bonheur.
Quiconque les récite verra son désir se réaliser sans aucun doute

verses.text: شَكٍّ وَمَنْ لَّمْ يَتْلُهَا لَنْ يُّقْبَلَا
verses.transcription: shakkin wa man lam yatluhaa lan yuqbalaa

translations.fr: et quiconque ne les récite ne sera pas exaucé dans ses prières.

verses.transcription: wa man talaahaa mukhlisan liwajhi man

translations.fr: Quiconque les récite sincèrement pour plaire à Dieu
qui les a révélés obtiendra une récompense et une sécurité.

verses.text: وَمَنْ بِهَا دَخَلَ فِى أَمْرٍ فَلَا
verses.transcription: wa man bihaa dakhala fii amrin falaa

translations.fr: Quiconque les récite au début de chaque entreprise
ne sera pas déçu dans son attente et n'échouera point.

verses.transcription: wa man bihaa raama haziizan naalahu

translations.fr: Quiconque dans son désir d'obtenir un bien précieux,
les récite, réussira grâce à l'Absolu qui m'a accordé sa beauté.

verses.transcription: wa man talaahaa fit tibaahin yuujari

translations.fr: Quiconque les récite en allant chez une personne généreuse et prospère,
l'accès de celle-ci ne lui sera pas interdit.

verses.transcription: wa man talaahaa wahwa zut tiqaa-i

translations.fr: Quiconque les récite en pieux obtiendra l'agrément

verses.transcription: naala ridaa man jaada bil baqaa-i

translations.fr: de celui qui excelle par son éternité.
Bénédiction et Paix sur Muhammad,

verses.transcription: wa aalihi wa sahbihi wal humadi

translations.fr: sur sa famille et ses compagnons qui louent Dieu continuellement.
De la part de celui qui a mis le coran recopié de la table bien gardée

verses.text: مِنْ لَّوْحِهِ فِى يَدِّ رُوحٍ نَّزَلَا
verses.transcription: min lawhihi fii yaddi ruuhin nazalaa

translations.fr: entre les mains de l'esprit saint (Gabriel).
Que la magnifique bénisse Muhammad et Gabriel et leur accorde le salut.

verses.transcription: wa kaana lii bifadlihi haysu amiil

translations.fr: Qu'il soit avec moi en me comblant de grâce partout où je me tourne.
Qu'il bénisse les deux par considération pour la famille de l'Elu,

verses.transcription: wa sahbihi wa kulli man naalas tafaa

translations.fr: et de ses compagnons par amour de Lui et pour l'amour de quiconque a été purifié.
Bénédiction et Salut sur tous,
de la part du meilleur Reconnaissant qui élève et qui entend.

verses.transcription: wa afdalus salaati mah khayri salaam

translations.fr: Que la meilleure bénédiction et la meilleure paix soient sur Eux deux
comme il l'a enseigné par la parole (dans le coran).

verses.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَفِى صَفَرْ
verses.transcription: salaatul lazii fii kulli shahrin wa fii safar

verses.text: حَمَانِى عَلَى مَاحٍ مَّحَا الْحَبْسَ وَالسَّفَرْ
verses.transcription: hamaanii halaa maahin mahal habsa was safar

verses.text: عَجِيبٌ بِهِ لِى جَادَ مُغْنٍ عَنِ النَّفَرْ
verses.transcription: hajiibun bihi lii jaada mughnin hanin nafar

verses.text: رَضِيتُ عَنِ الْمَوْلَى وَعَنْ خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ
verses.transcription: radiitu hanil mawlaa wa han khayri khalqihi

verses.text: عَلَيْهِ سَلَامَا مَنْ لَّهُ أُبْتُ بِالظَّفَرْ
verses.transcription: halayhi salaamaa man lahu ubtu biz zafar
salaatun wa tasliimun mahal bishri sarmadan

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ مُكْثِى مَعَ الْأَمْنِ وَالْبَشَرْ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi muksii mahal amni wal bashar

verses.text: فِرَارِىَ بِالْمُخْتَارِ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَادَ لِى
verses.transcription: firaariya bil mukhtaari min qablu qaada lii
mukuusan wa tabshiran ladal jinni wal bashar

verses.text: لِّبَاقٍ مَحَا ضُرِّى الَّذِى حَازَهُ الْقَدَرْ
verses.transcription: libaaqin mahaa durril lazii haazahul qadar

verses.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى أَدْعُوهُ عَبْدًا لَّهُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: salaatul lazii adhuuhu habdan lahu bihi

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لِى قَادَ صَفْوًا بِلَا كَدَرْ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi lii qaada safwan bilaa kadar

verses.text: وَكَوْنِى بِهَا عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا لَّهُ ظَهَرْ
verses.transcription: wa kawnii bihaa habdan khadiiman lahu zahar

verses.text: رَبِحْتُ رَبَاحًا لَّمْ يَكُنْ قَطُّ مِثْلُهُ
verses.transcription: rabihtu rabaahan lam yakun qattu misluhu

verses.text: بِفَضْلِ الَّذِى كَوْنِى حَبِيبًا لَّهُ اشْتَهَرْ
verses.transcription: bifadlil lazii kawnii habiiban lahush tahar

verses.text: صَلَاةُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ كَوْنِى خَلِيلَهُ
verses.transcription: salaatul lazii lii qaada kawnii khaliilahu

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لِى طَيَّبَ الْبَدْوَ وَالْحَضَرْ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi lii tayyabal badwa wal hadar

verses.text: بِجَاهِ الَّذِى بَاهَتْ بِهِ مَنْ عَلَوْ مُضَرْ
verses.transcription: bijaahil lazii baahat bihi man halaw mudar

verses.text: رَبَاحِىَ فِى إِخْدَامِ خَيْرِ الْوَرَى بَدَا
verses.transcription: rabaahiya fii ikhdaami khayril waraa badaa

verses.text: وَفِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ زَيْدُ رِبْحِى وَفِى صَفَرْ
verses.transcription: wa fii kulli shahrin zaydu ribhii wa fii safar

verses.text: رَفَعْتَ مَا ظَهَرَ لِى وَمَا بَطَنْ
verses.transcription: rafahta maa zahara lii wa maa batan

verses.text: بَرَكْتَ لِى فِيمَا انْجَلَى وَمَا اسْتَكَنّْ
verses.transcription: barakta lii fiiman jalaa wa mas takann
wa zaahirii wa baatinii fiika sakan
mallaktanii makhtarta lii yaa zaz zaman
wa kunta lii bilan tihaa-in bil aman

verses.text: جَذَبْتَ لِى سِرًّا نَّفَى ذَوِى الْفِتَنْ
verses.transcription: jazabta lii sirran nafaa zawil fitan
was sahbi wal amlaaki hazzamtal minan

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ مِنِّى انْتَحَى مَالِى اتَّزَنْ
verses.transcription: yaa man lahu minnin tahaa maa lit tazan
lighayri durrii wa haduwwii lam yuhan
wa dahha rabbii mujrijiyya bid dadan
wa abadan aghnaa yadii han haati
man laa yazaalu qu-atii wa hawliyaa
wa lii taquudu abadan khayral maraam
kaana munaazi han wa akhzaahul malik

bayts.text: صَانَ إِلَاهِى بِالْمُنَى جِهَاتِى ۞ وَأَبَدًا أَغْنَى يَدِى عَنْ هَاتِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Dio ha custodito ogni mio orizzonte colmandolo di desideri esauditi, e per sempre ha reso la mia mano libera dal dover dire «dammi».
translations.en.karamati: My God has guarded my every horizon, filling it with granted wishes, and forever He has freed my hand from having to say "give me".
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Dieu a gardé chacun de mes horizons en le comblant de vœux exaucés, et à jamais Il a affranchi ma main d'avoir à dire « donne-moi ».

bayts.text: دَلَّ عَلَىَّ الْعُلَمَآ وَالْأَوْلِيَآ ۞ مَنْ لَّا يَزَالُ قُؤَتِى وَحَوْلِيَا

translations.it.karamati: Ha guidato a me i sapienti e i Santi (al-awliyāʾ) Colui (Allah) che non cessa d'essere la mia forza e la mia potenza.
translations.en.karamati: He (Allah) who never ceases to be my strength and my might has guided the learned and the Saints (al-awliyāʾ) to me.
translations.fr.karamati: A guidé vers moi les savants et les Saints (al-awliyāʾ) Celui (Allah) qui ne cesse d'être ma force et ma puissance.

bayts.text: قَصِيدَتِى فَاقَتْ قَصَآءِدَ الْكِرَامْ ۞ وَلِى تَقُودُ أَبَدًا خَيْرَ الْمَرَامْ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio poema ha superato i poemi dei nobili, e per sempre conduce a me il più eccelso dei desideri.
translations.en.karamati: My ode has surpassed the odes of the noble, and forever it leads to me the most excellent of wishes.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon poème a surpassé les poèmes des nobles, et à jamais il conduit vers moi le plus excellent des vœux.

bayts.text: هَدِيَّتِى مُخْجِلَةٌ كُلَّ مَلِكْ ۞ كَانَ مُنَازِعًا وَأَخْزَاهُ الْمَلِكْ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio dono copre di vergogna ogni re che si è posto come rivale, e il Re (Allah) lo ha umiliato.
translations.en.karamati: My gift puts to shame every king who set himself up as a rival, and the King (Allah) has abased him.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon présent couvre de honte tout roi qui s'est posé en rival, et le Roi (Allah) l'a humilié.

bayts.text: مَحَاتَوَ جُّهَ النَّصَرَى اللَّهُ ۞ لِىَ بِلَآ إِلَاهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Allah ha cancellato, in mio favore, l'avanzata dei Nazareni (i colonizzatori cristiani), per mezzo di «Non vi è divinità all'infuori di Allah».
translations.en.karamati: God has erased, in my favour, the advance of the Nazarenes (the Christian colonisers), by "There is no god but God".
translations.fr.karamati: Dieu a effacé, en ma faveur, l'avancée des Nazaréens (les colonisateurs chrétiens), par « Il n'est de divinité que Dieu ».

translations.fr: Je me plains contre mes affaires et mon grand péché
auprès de mon Seigneur le Miséricordieux et le Clément.

verses.text: فَكُنْ مُّشْكِيًا لِّى وَهَبْ لِى الْمُنَى
verses.transcription: fakun mushkiyan lii wa hab lil munaa

translations.fr: Accepte Seigneur ma repentance et exause mes voeux
par la grâce du Grand Prophète, l'Intercepteur.
Et prie sur Lui sans arrêt,
et accorde-Lui la paix et la bénédiction pour toujours.

verses.transcription: wa kun lii waliyyan hunaa wa ghadan

translations.fr: Sois mon allié, ici (au bas-monde) et demain (l'au-dela),

verses.transcription: wa kun lii nasiiran fa-innii hadiim

translations.fr: et sois mon secoureur car je suis inexistant.

verses.text: وَكُنْ بِى لَطِيفًا وَهَبْ لِى رِضًى
verses.transcription: wa kun bii latiifan wa hab lii ridan

translations.fr: Sois doux en mon égard et accorde-moi la bénédiction,

verses.transcription: wa kun lii ghafuuran fa-innii muliim

translations.fr: et pardonne-moi car je suis blâmable.

verses.transcription: wa kun lii muhiinan halaa matlabii

translations.fr: Sois mon secours à ma demande,

verses.transcription: wa kun muqdiran lii fa-innii sa-im

translations.fr: sois mon destin car je suis pessimsiste.

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِى صَلَاحًا وَهَبْ لِى تُقًى
verses.transcription: wa hab lii salaahan wa hab lii tuqan

translations.fr: Accorde-moi le bon et accorde-moi la piété.

verses.transcription: wa nawwir janaanii wa zidnii huluum

translations.fr: Illumine mon coeur et donne-moi les sciences.

verses.transcription: wa hab lii najaatan wa zidnii hudan

translations.fr: Accorde-moi la vie sauve et renforce ma droiture.

verses.transcription: wa aslih umuurii wa zidnii nahiim

translations.fr: Rends parfait mes affaires et ajoute-moi de la jouissance.

verses.transcription: wa akhrij huyuubii wa zidnii hulan

translations.fr: Fais sortir mes vices et ajoute-moi l'élévation.

verses.transcription: wa abri saqaamii wa farrij ghumuum

translations.fr: Gueris ma maladie et soulage mes angoisses.
Ne m'humilie pas, protège-moi contre la perte.
Ne me fais pas honte parce que je suis maladroit.
Je suis maladroit, esclave de plaisir

verses.transcription: wa haasin wa laakin ilaahii haliim

translations.fr: et pécheur mais mon Seigneur est Clément.

verses.transcription: wa haafiyatan hab hunaa wa ghadan

translations.fr: Accorde-moi la quiétude ici-bas et au-delà,
pour moi et pour tous ceux qui suivent le droit chemin.
Prière et salut sur Moustapha
et accorde-Lui une bénédiction éternelle.

verses.transcription: wa artajii minhu fid daarayni abkaaraa

verses.text: كَتَبْتُ شُكْرًا لَّهُ مَا قَدْ رَجَوْتُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: katabtu shukran lahu maa qad rajawtu bihi
kawnii sahidan wa shakkaaran wa zakkaaraa

verses.text: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ فِى شَهْرٍ النَّبِى سَنَدِى
verses.transcription: wajjahtu wajhiya fii shahrinin nabii sanadii
wa rafhahul yawma hannii nihma ghaffaaraa
hannii wa tasjiirahu lid dahra kuffaaraa
wa lam yazal jalla qahhaaran wa jabbaaraa

verses.text: فَجَأْتَنِى رَبِّ بِالْئَالَالِ هَبْ لِىَ أَنْ
verses.transcription: faja-tanii rabbi bil aalaali hab liya an

verses.text: أَعُودُ لِلْبَرِّ رُضْ لِى كُلَّ مَنْ بَارَى
verses.transcription: ahuudu lil barri rud lii kulla man baaraa
halan nabii salli bit tasliimin bil kuramaa
warfah wa zidniya bahdar rafhi abkaaraa

bayts.text: شُكْرِى لِرَبٍّ كَرِيمٍ كَانَ شَكَّارَا ۞ وَأَرْتَجِى مِنْهُ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ أَبْكَارَا

translations.it.karamati: La mia gratitudine va a un Signore Generoso che è sommamente Riconoscente (Shakkār), e da Lui spero di ottenere, nelle due dimore, favori sempre nuovi e puri.
translations.en.karamati: My gratitude is for a Generous Lord who is ever-Grateful (Shakkār), and from Him I hope, in the two abodes, for ever-new and pure favours.
translations.fr.karamati: Ma gratitude va à un Seigneur Généreux, qui est Très Reconnaissant (Shakkār), et j'espère de Lui, dans les deux demeures, des faveurs toujours neuves et pures.

bayts.text: كَتَبْتُ شُكْرًا لَّهُ مَا قَدْ رَجَوْتُ بِهِ ۞ كَوْنِى سَعِدًا وَشَكَّارًا وَذَكَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho scritto, in segno di gratitudine verso di Lui, ciò grazie al quale spero di essere felice, eternamente grato e assiduo nel Suo ricordo (Dhikr).
translations.en.karamati: I have written, in gratitude to Him, that through which I hope to be fortunate, grateful and ever mindful of Him (Dhikr).
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai écrit, en signe de gratitude envers Lui, ce par quoi j'espère être heureux, reconnaissant et assidu dans Son rappel (Dhikr).

bayts.text: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ فِى شَهْرٍ النَّبِى سَنَدِى ۞ لِىلْأَكْرِمِ الرَّافِعِ الْوَهَّابِ شَكَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto il mio volto, nel mese del Profeta mio sostegno, al Generosissimo, Colui che eleva i ranghi (Ar-Rāfi'), il Donatore supremo, con animo grato.
translations.en.karamati: I turned my face, in the month of the Prophet, my support, to the Most Generous, the Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), the Bestower, in gratitude.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tourné ma face, durant le mois du Prophète, mon soutien, vers le Très Généreux, Celui qui élève (Ar-Rāfiʿ), le Grand Donateur, avec gratitude.

bayts.text: رَجَوْتُ مِنْهُ تَعَالَى شُكْرَهُ عَمَلِى ۞ وَرَفْعَهُ الْيَوْمَ عَنِّى نِعْمَ غَفَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho sperato da Lui — l'Altissimo — che gradisca e ricompensi la mia opera e che oggi stesso mi elevi; che eccellente Perdonatore Egli è!
translations.en.karamati: I hoped from Him, the Most High, that He would accept my work with gratitude and raise me today; what an excellent Forgiver!
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai espéré de Lui, le Très-Haut, qu'Il agrée mon œuvre avec reconnaissance et qu'Il m'élève aujourd'hui ; quel excellent Pardonneur !

bayts.text: رَجَوْتُ أَنْ يَمْحُو الزَّلَّاتِ جُمْلَتَهَا ۞ عَنِّى وَتَسْخِيرَهُ لِى الدَّهْرَ كُفَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: Ho sperato che Egli cancelli da me tutte le mie mancanze nella loro totalità, e che assoggetti a me per sempre i miscredenti.
translations.en.karamati: I hoped that He would efface from me all my slips in their entirety, and subject to me the unbelievers forever.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai espéré qu'Il efface de moi toutes mes fautes dans leur totalité, et qu'Il me soumette à jamais les mécréants.

bayts.text: إِنِّى أُخَاطِبُهُ فِى الْبَحْرِ مُغْتَرِبًا ۞ وَلَمْ يَزَلْ جَلَّ قَهَّارًا وَجَبَّارَا

translations.it.karamati: In verità mi rivolgo a Lui in mezzo al mare mentre sono in esilio, ed Egli — sublime sia la Sua Maestà — non cessa di essere il Dominatore irresistibile (Qahhār) e l'Onnipotente che risana (Jabbār).
translations.en.karamati: Truly I address Him in the midst of the sea, in exile, and He, majestic is He, never ceases to be the Subduer (Qahhār) and the Compeller who restores (Jabbār).
translations.fr.karamati: En vérité, je m'adresse à Lui au milieu de la mer, en exil, et Il ne cesse d'être — que Sa Majesté soit exaltée — le Dominateur (Qahhār) et le Contraignant réparateur (Jabbār).

bayts.text: فَجَأْتَنِى رَبِّ بِالْئَالَالِ هَبْ لِىَ أَنْ ۞ أَعُودُ لِلْبَرِّ رُضْ لِى كُلَّ مَنْ بَارَى

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai sorpreso, o Signore, con grazie meravigliose: concedimi di fare ritorno sulla terraferma e piega a mio favore chiunque mi osteggi o competi con me.
translations.en.karamati: You surprised me, O Lord, with blessings; grant me that I return to dry land, and subdue for me whoever contends with me.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as surpris, ô Seigneur, par des bienfaits ; accorde-moi de retourner à la terre ferme, et soumets-moi quiconque me rivalise ou me combat.

bayts.text: عَلَى النَّبِى صَلِّ بِالتَّسْلِيمٍ بِالْكُرَمَآ ۞ وَارْفَعْ وَزِدْنِىَ بَعْدَ الرَّفْعِ أَبْكَارَا

translations.it.karamati: Sul Profeta riversa benedizione e pace, insieme ai suoi nobili familiari e Compagni, ed elevami e accrescimi, dopo tale elevazione, di doni vergini e mai visti prima.
translations.en.karamati: Send blessings and peace upon the Prophet, with the noble ones, and raise me, and increase me, after the raising, with ever-new gifts.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur le Prophète prie avec le salut, ainsi que sur ses nobles, et élève-moi et accrois-moi, après l'élévation, de faveurs toujours neuves.

verses.transcription: yal laahu bil mustafas sindiidi yal laahu

translations.fr: Ô mon Dieu ! Je t'invoque par considération pour l'Elu, le noble et généreux, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Ya Allah! I implore thee by the blessings of Mustapha Ya Allah! And by the blessings of thy beloved friend Abraham Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bi khaliilika ibraahiima yal laahu

translations.fr: Et par considération pour ton ami Abraham, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: And by the blessings of thy interlocutor Moses, and Salih, Al Khidr, and by the blessings of Shu’aib, and by the blessings of Ishmael Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bi kaliimika muusaa saalihin khadirin

translations.fr: Par considération pour ton Interlocuteur Moussa, Sâlih, Khâdr,
translations.en: And by the blessings of Solomon, Noah, Jonah, Job, and by the blessings of Zakariah, John, and Hud O Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bi shuhaybin wa ismaahiila yal laahu

translations.fr: Chouaïb et Ismaîl, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: By the blessings of Aaron, Joshua, Elias, Adam, David, by the blessings of Dhul-kifl, Jesus, and Lot. Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bi sulaymaana nuuhin yuunusal yasahi

translations.fr: Par considération pour Salomon, Noé, Jonas, Yasa,
translations.en: By the blessings of Joseph, Isaac, and others among thy apostles and messengers Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa zakariyyaa-a yahyaa huuda yal laahu

translations.fr: Zakaria et Jean Baptiste, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: And by the blessings of the unity of the Angels, and those among them encompassed with the purest, Divine Essence such as Gabriel and Michael Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: haruuna yuushuha ilyaasin wa aadama daa

translations.fr: Hâron, Josué, Elie, Adam,
translations.en: By the blessings of Israfil who is entrusted with Blowing the Trumpet, and Azrael who shall duly seize the soul of every creature Ya Allah!

verses.text: وُودَ وَذِى الْكِفْلِ عِيسَى لُوطَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wuuda wa zil kifli hiisaa luuta yal laahu

translations.fr: David, Dûl Kifli, Jésus, Loth, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: By the blessings of the companions of the Prophet and the friends of Allah, as well as those who actively practice their knowledge among the people of religious Authority Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa yuusufin wa bi is-haaqin wa ghayrihimu

translations.fr: Par Joseph et par Isaac, et par d'autres prophètes
translations.en: By the blessings of Abu Bakr the truthful, Omar who distinguished truth from falsehood, Uthman the possessor of two lights, and Ali, the father of the two grandsons of the Prophet Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: minan biyaa-in wa ruslin laka yal laahu

translations.fr: et apôtres qui sont les tiens, Ô mon Dieu.
translations.en: By the blessings of Imam Malik, the highly distinguished, Imam As Shafi, Imam Abu Hanafi, and the praiseworthy, Imam Ahmad Ibn Hanbal Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bil malaa-iki turran summa safwatihim

translations.fr: Par tous les Anges, ensuite leur élite,
translations.en: By the blessings of the Exalted Pen, the Preserved Tablet, thy Magnificent Throne and Exalted Footstool Ya Allah!!

translations.fr: Gabriel, par Michel, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: By the blessings of the Quran, the Torah, The Psalms of David, and the Gospel of the Spirit of God, Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa saahibin nafkhi israafiila qaabidi ar

translations.fr: Et par le souffleur [de la trompête] Izrâfil,
translations.en: Transmit my salutations of peace and blessings upon him ( the Prophet), his family, companions, and wives Ya Allah!

translations.fr: par le ravisseur de l'âme des êtres vivants Izrâ'îl, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: O Lord! Drape over us the cover of well-being and bestow upon us our goals in this world and in the Hereafter Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bis sahaabati summal awliyaa-i mahan

translations.fr: Par les compagnons [du Prophète], puis par les saints
translations.en: Open for us all gates of graces that thou hath opened to those endowed with a complete state of piety Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wal haamiliina minal ahbaari yal laahu

translations.fr: et l'ensemble des docteurs de la loi, les ulémas, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Impel us to trod on the distinct path of righteousness, Preserve us from the pitfalls and from the Evils of the Jinn and Satan Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bis siddiiqi wa bil faaruuqi summa bizin

translations.fr: Par [Abou Bakr], le véridique, par [Omar], le Séparateur [du bien et du mal],
translations.en: Grant us all our ambitions, allow us to attain our objectives, bestow upon us any grace we choose Ya Allah.

verses.transcription: nuurayni summa abis sibtayni yal laahu

translations.fr: puis par l'homme aux deux lumières [Ousmane], puis par [Alioune] le père des deux Petits-fils [du Prophète]
translations.en: Soften for us the hearts of any possessor of reluctance and oppression, smoothen all the hardships Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: bi maalikin zil mazaayash shaafihiyyi abii

translations.fr: Par Mâlik [Ibn 'Anas], le trés distingué, par [Muhammad ibn' Idrîs] Achafi,
translations.en: Prolong our lives, strengthen our bodies, bestow guidance upon us, and grant us felicity (tawfiq) O Allah!

translations.fr: par Abou Hanîfa, par Ahmad [Ibn Man-hal] le digne d'éloges, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Destroy any enemy whose intention is to cause harm before he gains access to us Ya Allah! Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: bil lawhi wal qalamil mahfuuzi summa bihar

translations.fr: Par la table, par la Plume bien gardée,
translations.en: Protect us from all kinds of ruin, deliver us from the calamities of the world, all the time Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: shikal haziimi wa bil kursiyyi yal laahu

translations.fr: puis par ton trône immense et par le Siège, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Protect us from epidemics, illness, agony, afflictions, vehement earthquakes as well as poverty Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa bil qur-aani wa bit tawriiti summa bimaa

translations.fr: Par le Coran, la Thawra, par les Psaumes de David
translations.en: Protect us from blemishes, insufficiency, from the fury of a tyrant, vileness, debility, hunger and thirst Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: daawudu jaa-a bihi war ruuhu yal laahu

translations.fr: et l'Evangile de Jésus l'Esprit, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Protect us from all forms of trials, from disease from being burnt in fire, from being drowned in water, from lightning, thunder, theft and vain labor Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: balligh salaati wa tasliimii halayhi lahu

translations.fr: Fais parvenir la bénédiction et le salut [de ma part] à lui [le Prophète],
translations.en: Protect us from excessive heat and cold, from plundering, from oppression, from hostility, from delusion, from grief, and from being paralyzed Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wal aali was sahbi wal azwaaji yal laahu

translations.fr: aux siens et à ses épouses, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Protect us from anxiety, from transgression, from stumbling in error, from transmutation, and from defamation Ya Allah!

translations.fr: Seigneur ! Fais descendre sur nous le voile de la bonne santé,
translations.en: Protect us from lack of sustenance, from the influences of evil spirits, and from fading away due to illness Ya Allah!

verses.text: وَهَبْ لَنَا الْقَصْدَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa hab lanal qasda fid daarayni yal laahu

translations.fr: exauce nos voeux ici-bas et dans l'au-delà ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Protect us from the evils of this world and of the next as well as their dreadful humiliations Ya Allah!Ya Allah!

verses.text: وَافْتَحْ لَنَا كُلَّ بَابٍ كُنْتَ فَاتِحَهُ
verses.transcription: waftah lanaa kulla baabin kunta faatihahu

translations.fr: Ouvre-nous toute porte de bienfaits,
translations.en: O thou who hath power over all things, overwhelming the entire creation, being firmly established in Thine Magnificent Throne of Authority Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: lis saalihiina minal khayraati yal laahu

translations.fr: ouverte par toi pour les vertueux ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Verily, I beg thee for a fearing heart and a humble one, an extensive knowledge of tremendous use Ya Allah!

verses.text: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا نَهْجَ رُشْدٍ وَاكْفِنَا زَلَلًا
verses.transcription: wasluk binaa nahja rushdin wakfinaa zalalan

translations.fr: Engage-nous dans le droit chemin. Evite-nous tout faux pas.
translations.en: I beg thee for an accepted repentance, a lofty station, a virtuous and pious wife O God!

verses.transcription: watrud lanal jinna wash shaytaana yal laahu

translations.fr: Chasse loin de nous djinns et satan ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Be our fortress against the evils of the possessor of envy, against the evils of the tongue, as well as against the evils of the eye Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa kammilan kullamaa nanhuu wa naqsuduhu

translations.fr: Fais-nous obtenir complètement tout ce que nous désirons,
translations.en: Be our refuge against the evils of sorcery, the evils of the creatures, men or jinns, and against the evils of venomous creatures Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa hab lanaa kullamaa nakhtaaru yal laahu

translations.fr: et tout but que nous voulons atteindre. Donne-nous tout ce que nous aurons à choisir, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: O mine confident! I take Thee in this world and in the hereafter as my inaccessible fortress: the one in whom I seek shelter Ya Allah!

verses.text: وَرُضْ لَنَا كُلَّ ذِى صَعْبٍ وَذِى حَرَنٍ
verses.transcription: wa rud lanaa kulla zii sahbin wa zii haranin

translations.fr: Aplanis pour nous toute difficulté et toute complication
translations.en: Abandon me not with my own soul (nafs), lest I go astray: be responsive whenever I beseech thee Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa yassiran kulla zit tahsiiri yal laahu

translations.fr: Résous au mieux tout problème difficile ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Cause my tongue and my heart to remember Thee and to hold a perfect belief in Thee at the crucial moment of death Ya Allah!

verses.text: طَوِّلْ لَّنَا عُمْرَنَا صَحِّحْ لّنَا بَدَنًا
verses.transcription: tawwil lanaa humranaa sahhih lanaa badanan

translations.fr: Accorde-nous une longue vie ! Donne-nous une excellente santé !
translations.en: Establish permanently in mine heart the knowledge of Certainty (Yaqin); Let no fear abide therein, until I passionately love Thy Ultimate encounter Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa hab lanar rushda wat tawfiiqa yal laahu

translations.fr: Apporte-nous la bonne direction et la félicité ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Cause my death to be the announcement of good news, and to be a complete rest, and to be a protection against all pain, distress and fear Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa dammiran kulla ahdaa-in tudirru binaa

translations.fr: Ecrase tous les ennemis qui veulent nous nuire
translations.en: Shield my body against tortures in the grave, whenever the soul is separated from me. Let it not undergo any deterioration nor hardship. Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: qablal wusuuli lanaa yal laahu yal laahu

translations.fr: avant qu'ils ne nous atteignent, Ô mon Dieu ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Be my Assistant and Companion at the time my body is buried in the grave, where I may become lonely Ya Allah!

verses.text: وَكُنْ لَّنَا عَاصِمًا مِّنْ كُلِّ مَهْلَكَةٍ
verses.transcription: wa kun lanaa haasiman min kulli mahlakatin

translations.fr: Sois notre Protecteur contre toute cause de mort.
translations.en: Join me not with that which causes terror in the grave, preserve me from anything that I fear Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa najjinaa min balaa yad dahra yal laahu

translations.fr: Sauve-nous de tous les malheurs et pour toujours, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Protect me, my mother and all those who bow to Thy will, Amen Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa aafatin haahatin mah ghussatin mihanin

translations.fr: Préserve-nous de tout dommage, de tout sinistre, de la suffocation, de toutes les épreuves,
translations.en: Forgive us and my mother, cover our defects, bestow benevolence upon us and her; protect us from terror Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: zalzalatin shiddatin wal faqri yal laahu

translations.fr: du tremblement de terre, du malheur et de la pauvreté ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Grant us complete forgiveness, have mercy on her. She has no one but Thee; and verily Thou art the kind One Ya Allah!

translations.fr: Préserve-nous [aussi] de l'avilissement, de la pénurie de l'achoppement, de la défaite,
translations.en: Be with us in the barzakh and in the grave, preserve us from any distress or any kind of fear Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa faaqatin hatashin wal juuhi yal laahu

translations.fr: de la misère, de la soif et de la faim ! Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Do not afflict my mother with that which she can not bear and do not disappoint the hope she has in Thee Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa fitnatin wal wabaa wal harqi mah gharaqin

translations.fr: Préserve-nous de l'épreuve, de l'épidémie de l'incendie ainsi que de la noyade,
translations.en: Quench our thirst and hers in the water of Kauthar, which Thou has reserved for the one whom Thou hath chosen over the entire creation Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wal barqi mah saraqin wal kaddi yal laahu

translations.fr: de l'éclair, du vol et de la peine, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: That was he who provided guidance to he who roamed in error, destroyed he who rejected faith and yielded aid to he who had innermost fear in Thee Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: harrin wa bardin wa nahbin kurbatin niqamin

translations.fr: Préserve-nous de la chaleur, du froid, du pillage, de la calamité, de la vengeance,
translations.en: Such a one was Muhammad, the Fine Flower of the elect, who will lead us into the everlasting Paradise on the Day of Resurrection Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: dalaalatin harajin wal ghammi yal laahu

translations.fr: de l'égarement, de la claudication et du chagrin, Ô mon Dieu !
translations.en: Upon him be Eternal peace and blessings, forever and ever, and upon any who follows him till Doomsday Ya Allah!

verses.transcription: wa haammatin wa khataa yaa daallatin zalalin

translations.fr: Préserve-nous des insectes, des péchés, de la perte, des faux pas,

verses.transcription: wal maskhi wal khasfi summal qazfi yal laahu

translations.fr: de la transformation en monstres, de la calomnie, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa ghullatin mah junuunin hillatin maradin

translations.fr: Préserve-nous du dérangement de l'esprit, de la folie, de l'indisposition, de la maladie,

verses.transcription: summal juzaamayni wan nuqsaani yal laahu

translations.fr: des deux sortes de lèpres, de la diminution physique, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa min qabiihati dunyaa summa aakhiratin

translations.fr: Préserve-nous de la laideur de ce monde et decelle de l'au-delà,

verses.transcription: wa min fuduuhihimaa yal laahu yal laahu

translations.fr: et de leur scandale, Ô mon Dieu ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: يَامَنْ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ  قَادِرٌ وَعَلَى
verses.transcription: yaa man halaa kulli shay-in qaadirun wa halal

translations.fr: Ô toi qui peut tout faire, toi qui t'installes sur ton grand trône

verses.transcription: harshil haziimis tawaa bil qahri yal laahu

translations.fr: par la force coercitive ! Ô mon Dieu !
Je te demande un coeur doué pour Toi d'un saint respect,

verses.transcription: dihan wa hilman kasiiran nafhi yal laahu

translations.fr: de la modestie et une science trés utile, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa tawbaatan qubilat mah miknatin rufihat

translations.fr: Je te demande aussi un repentir agréé, une place élevée,

verses.transcription: mah zawjatin salluhat bid diini yal laahu

translations.fr: une femme vertueuse et pieuse, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: وَكُنْ مُّعِيذًا لَّنَا مِنْ شَرِّ ذِى حَسَدٍ
verses.transcription: wa kun muhiizan lanaa min sharri zii hasadin

translations.fr: Sous celui qui nous protège contre le mal du jaloux,

verses.text: مَعْ شَرِّ فَمٍّ  وَشَرِّ الْعَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: mah sharri fammin wa sharril hayni yal laahu

translations.fr: celui de la bouche et celui de l'oeil ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa sharri sihrin wa sharril khalqi insihimu

translations.fr: Sois notre abri contre le mal de la magie, celui des êtres créés, hommes

verses.transcription: mah jinnihim wa zawaatis sumi yal laahu

translations.fr: et djinns et celui des êtres venimeux, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: innii jahaltuka fid daarayni yaa siqatii

translations.fr: Ô ma Confiance ! je te prends dans les deux demeures pour un abri sûr.

verses.transcription: hisnan hasinan fakun maljaaya yal laahu

translations.fr: Sois mon lieu de refuge ! Ô mon Dieu !
Ne m'abandonnes pas à moi-même ! [Si tu le fais,] je périrais.
Sois celui qui exauce partout où je t'invoque. Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wajhal lisaanii wa qalbii zaakirayka mahan

translations.fr: Fais que ma langue et mon coeur, dans la foi,

verses.transcription: hindal mamaati mahal iimaani yal laahu

translations.fr: disent ton nom quand je mourrai ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: ثَبِّتْ يَقِينِىَ فِى قَلْبِى بِلَا وَجَلٍ
verses.transcription: sabbit yaqiiniya fii qalbii bilaa wajalin

translations.fr: Rive solidement ma certitude dans mon coeur sans angoisse

verses.transcription: hattaa uhibba liqaakal haqqa yal laahu

translations.fr: jusqu'à ce que je désire vraiment te rencontrer, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa lij halil mawta raahaatin wa mafrahatan

translations.fr: Fais que ma mort soit source de repos et de joie qui m'éloigne

verses.text: مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ وَكَرْبٍ ضَاقَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: min kulli sharrin wa karbin daaqa yal laahu

translations.fr: de tout mal et de toute contraignante calamité ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: وَاحْفَظْ لِىَ الْجِسْمَ حَيْثُ الرُّوحُ فَارَقَنِى
verses.transcription: wahfaz liyal jisma haysur ruuhu faaraqanii

translations.fr: Veille sur mon coeur lorsque l'âme me quittera.

verses.text: فِى الْقَبْرِ لَا تُبْلِيَنْهُ الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fil qabri laa tubliyanhud dahra yal laahu

translations.fr: Et dans la tombe, ne lui fais jamais subir une épreuve, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa kun nasiiri aniisii hiinamaa dafanuu

translations.fr: Sois mon aide et mon compagnon lorsqu'ils auront enterré mon corps

verses.transcription: jismii fasirtu wa hiidaan samma yal laahu

translations.fr: et que je reste seul ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: لَا تَضْمُمَنَّ مَعِى مَا قَدْ يُرَوِّ عُنِى
verses.transcription: laa tadmumanna mahii maa qad yurawwi hunii

translations.fr: Ne m'enveloppe point avec ce qui pourrait m'effrayer mais au contraire,

verses.transcription: balik fiyan kullamaa akhshaahu yal laahu

translations.fr: protège-moi contre tout ce que je craindrai, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: wa najjiinii wa jamiihal musliimiina mahan

translations.fr: Sauve-moi, tous les musulmans ensemble.

verses.transcription: wa najji waalidatii aamina yal laahu

translations.fr: Sauve ma mère ! Amen ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهَا وَاسْتُر مَعَآ ئِبَنَا
verses.transcription: waghfir lanaa wa lahaa wastur mahaa ibanaa

translations.fr: Pardonne-nous, ainsi qu'à elle ! Cache nos vices.

verses.text: وَالْطُفْ بِنَا وَبِهَا فِى الْهَوْلِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: waltuf binaa wa bihaa fil hawli yal laahu

translations.fr: Sois bienveillant pour nous et pour elle dans la déroute, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: hanha tajaawaz wa iyyaanar hamanna famaa

translations.fr: Laisse nos péchés et les siens impunis ! Aie pitié !

verses.transcription: lanaa siwaaka wa antal barru yal laahu

translations.fr: Elle n'a d'autre que Toi. Et tu es bon, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: فِى بَرْزَخٍ مَّعَ قَبْرٍ كُنْ لَّهَا وَزَرًا
verses.transcription: fii barzakhin maha qabrin kun lahaa wazaran

translations.fr: Au purgatoire ainsi que dans la tombe, sois notre appui.

verses.transcription: wa min kuruubin wa khawfin najji yal laahu

translations.fr: Et des épreuves et de la peur sauve nous ! Ô mon Dieu !
Ne lui fait pas subir ce qu'elle ne peut supporter !

verses.transcription: walaa tukhayyib rajaahaa fiika yal laahu

translations.fr: Ne trompe pas son espoir en toi ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: وَأَسْقِنَا مَعَهَا مِنْ مَّآءِ كَوْثَرِ مَنْ
verses.transcription: wa asqiina mahahaa min maa-i kawsari man

translations.fr: Abreuve-nous ainsi qu'elle dans la source de kawthara donnée par toi à celui

verses.transcription: ikhtartahu min jamiihil khalqi yal laahu

translations.fr: que tu as choisi d'entre les créatures dans leur totalité ! Ô mon Dieu !

verses.text: مَنْ كَانَ يُرْشِدُ ذَا غَىٍّ وَيُهْلِكُ ذَا
verses.transcription: man kaana yurshidu zaa ghayyin wa yuhliku zaa

translations.fr: Celui qui guidait dans le droit chemin l'égaré, qui tuait le mécréant

verses.transcription: kufrin wa yansuru man yakhshaaka yal laahu

translations.fr: et qui aidait celui qui te craignait, Ô mon Dieu !
[J'ai nommé] Mouhammad, la fine fleur des choisis, notre guide jusqu'au

verses.transcription: lijannatil khuldi yawmal hashri yal laahu

translations.fr: Paradis éternel, le jour du Rassemblement, Ô mon Dieu !

verses.transcription: halayhi salli wa sallim daa-iman abadan

translations.fr: Accorde-lui, à jamais et pour toujours bénédiction et salut

verses.transcription: wa man khafawhu liyawmid diini yal laahu
